frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole living Temnodontosaurus platyodon with body layout and scale anchored to NHMUK PV OR2003; same-species comparative skull/tooth material used with specimen boundaries explicit. Not a scanned complete soft-tissue specimen.

scientific_limits.en: OR2003 is a flattened historical mounted skeleton, not a three-dimensional body mould; restored bone intervals and spread ribs are not exact living dimensions. Larkin et al2023 report6.83m skeletal length. Flesh thickness, body width, fin soft margins, dorsal fin, upper tail lobe and color are inferred. Comparative R122 tooth/R123 jaw are different individuals. Paul table R1157 assignment is not used because R1157 belongs to T.eurycephalus. Historical risor skull photograph is excluded from modeling rather than assuming disputed synonymy.
scientific_limits.zh: OR2003是压扁并装架的历史骨架，不是三维软体模具，补配处及铺开的肋骨不能当活体精确尺寸。Larkin等2023报告骨架长6.83米。肉体厚度、宽度、鳍缘、背鳍、尾上叶及颜色推定。R122牙与R123下颌为不同个体；不使用Paul表R1157的归属和8.5米数值，R1157属T.eurycephalus。旧risor头骨照片排除建模，不凭有争议同义关系套用。

original_scope.en: Planned animal asset: large tooth-bearing skull and deep robust body.
original_scope.zh: 规划中的动物资产：大型有齿头骨与深厚躯干。

evidence_anchors.body: Emoke Denes2018 photo7 actual NHM skeleton numbered2003 above lower skull/partial column; upper specimen gives long skull, substantial ribcage and four long paddles. Lower specimen is not appended as another head. Photo8 a separate upper displayed T.platyodon skeleton (consistent with OR2918 placement, accession not independently readable) supplies only supplementary tailbend/limb layout, not OR2003 measurements.
evidence_anchors.scale: Larkin et al2023 Excavating the Rutland Sea Dragon, comparison section explicitly OR2003=6.83m; OR2918 separately approximately6m. The Rutland10m skeleton itself is not this model.
evidence_anchors.teeth: Godefroit1993 actual R122 tooth Plate8C-D3cm bar and Fig16; crown laterally compressed, spatulate pointed cutting outline. R123 lower jaw Plate8A-B. Text reports such cutting crowns in BMNH2003 too. These are not narrow pin teeth or blunt molar plates.
evidence_anchors.classification: Martin et al2012 recognizes T.platyodon as type species and discusses carinate teeth/large prey niche; use only its T.platyodon comparison, not new T.azerguensis long slender tooth-reduced skull.
evidence_anchors.fins: Original photos show long narrow paddles and substantial hindfins, not Ophthalmosaurus tiny hindpaddles. Martin2012 non-thunnosaurian fore/hind broadly comparable; do not make exact equal-length claim from distorted mount.

scale.interpretation: Only published6.83m is reported skeleton measurement. All subordinate targets are conservative modeled proportions, not caliper readings from OR2003. Three-dimensional body volume and soft fin outlines inferred. Skull occupies roughly24percent of full length; orbit/jaw ratio about0.18, not Ophthalmosaurus0.28.

morphology: Large robust elongated tooth-bearing head transitions without an exposed long neck into a deep muscular streamlined torso. Rostrum long but substantial, not needlethin Leptonectes or short broad T.eurycephalus.

Conspicuous pointed cutting crowns with broad bases and modest labiolingual compression. Use approximately28 visible teeth per jaw side as simplified representation, not an established exact count; larger mid-row crowns. Jaws open about12degrees to expose real tooth-bearing gate without giant tusks. No serration detail invented at low-poly scale.

Deep fusiform torso carries strong dorsal and ventral mass, not a skeletal slab or thin cylinder. Ribcage spread does not directly set body width. No fossil matrix/support rods or open cranial fenestrae.

Four long tapered paddles, hindpair substantial and only moderately smaller than forepair. Smooth fleshed continuous fin membranes without separate clawed toes, not enormous broad round Ophthalmosaurus forefins with minute hindfins.

Long muscular tail stock tapers to a downturned skeletal lower lobe with a modest inferred upper soft-tissue lobe. Vertical tail plane, never horizontal cetacean flukes. Dorsal fin modest and swept, explicitly inferred, no soft-tissue claim from OR2003.
Paired lateral eyes considerably smaller externally than skeletal orbital openings; avoid huge googly scleral plates. Restrained dark gray-brown dorsum/light ventrum is artistic inference.

shape_gate.required_combination: Large robust tooth-bearing skull and deep powerful torso, with substantial four-paddle plan; complete animal retained.
shape_gate.comparisons: Ophthalmosaurus has much larger relative orbit, broad forefins and markedly reduced hindfins; Stenopterygius has narrower overall head/body and adult tooth reduction. Temnodontosaurus must retain large visible cutting teeth, robust skull and deep volume plus substantial hindpaddles, not merely scaled existing fishbody.
acceptance: Lateral and perspective reveal broad-based cutting tooth row and large skull merging into deep muscular body.
Top shows substantial rostrum/head and body width plus four long tapered fins, not needlejaw.
Hindpaddles clearly substantial relative to forepaddles, paired eyes not enormous exposed orbital rings.
No R1157/T.eurycephalus, risor juvenile, azerguensis toothless rostrum, trigonodon mount, or Rutland10m specimen substitution.

diagnostic_targets: Compact deep ribcage behind a short neck and small beaked head with large eye region.
Relatively short thigh and elongated shin/foot support a light terrestrial biped.
Short free grasping arms with five-fingered hands, no Iguanodon thumb spike.
Long narrow balancing tail, no tree-climbing curled tail or kangaroo tail-support stance.
No invented armour, cranial crest, horns or obligatory feather coat.

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole large browsing marsupial with long specialized compressed foreclaws and retracted nasal region, using a conservative mobile upper lip rather than a trunk.

scientific_limits.en: No complete skeleton is known. This original whole-animal reconstruction combines separate skull and limb fossils; body length, coat, ears, tail and fleshed proportions are estimates. High retracted nasals do not establish a trunk: Museums Victoria favors a mobile lip/tongue. Elbow posture follows2021 range-of-motion study, not absolute joint fusion. Digit allocation and claw sheaths are incomplete/inferred; the real unguals figured are unassociated.
scientific_limits.zh: 未发现完整骨架；完整活体以不同颅骨和肢骨组合复原，体长、皮毛、耳、尾及软组织比例为估计。后缩高鼻区不证明长鼻，Museums Victoria近年解释偏向可动唇和舌。肘姿态按2021运动范围研究，非绝对骨性融合；孤立爪骨的指位及角质鞘不完整，明确推断。

scale.body_status: Original proportional estimates for buffalo-sized animal, not measurements of one complete specimen.
scale.reference_status: Image estimate: Fig9 panelA spans about1.34 times50mm bar; unsheathed unassociated ungual, not published caliper value.
scale.claw_status: Conservative original keratin-sheath estimate~40% longer than referenced bony contour, within broad comparison range; no exact preserved sheath claimed.
scale.mass_context: 2019 femur-based largest P.azael estimate1160kg; highly derived humerus can overestimate. Not a body-volume target or exact individual mass.

diagnostic_targets: Elongate relatively narrow face with high retracted nasal region and a short flexible upper lip; no long elephant trunk or massive round wombat snout.
Long powerful forelimbs have bent and outward-set elbows; do not make four vertical rhino columns or a knuckle-walking sloth.
Several clearly separated long sickle-like foreclaws: deep in side view but laterally thin, not round bear nails or broad digging shovels.
Massive long torso and strong neck, narrower hindlimb stance than forelimbs; no kangaroo jumping posture.
Hindfeet support coherent whole-body stance, joints distinct, no hooves. Fine digit identities incompletely known, do not claim exact recovered manus.
Neutral understated coat, small rounded ears and moderate tapering tail are original soft-tissue inferences.

scientific_limits.en: Body length about1.2mm is estimated from the published0.5mm scale bars, not a published caliper measurement. Fossil lacks complete appendages: restored limbs follow Dunlop1996 reconstruction as reproduced by JNCC, not direct preservation. Body depth, posture, subtle eyes and color are interpretive.
scientific_limits.zh: 体长约1.2毫米按公开0.5毫米图尺估计，非游标实测。化石附肢不完整，按JNCC转载Dunlop1996同种完整复原补配；不宣称化石全部保存。厚度、姿态、细小眼区及颜色为解释性推断。

scale.uncertainty: Approximate1.1–1.3mm body from two independent reproductions of0.5mm scale; choose1.2mm with~15% tolerance. Limbs follow reconstruction proportions, not fossil-measured lengths.

anatomy: Broad, oval abdomen widest anterior-middle and rounded posterior, attached broadly to triangular/subtriangular carapace with pointed anterior apex. No narrow spider pedicel.

Raised broad anterior abdominal tergite2–3 as labeled in source, then transverse abdominal plates with median and lateral subdivisions; terminal dorsal plate9 broad and undivided. Do not copy Trigonotarbus separate2/3 or pear-shaped posterior taper blindly.

Four pairs of articulated walking legs, two pairs directed anterior/outward and two lateral/posterior; long enough to match whole-animal drawing, not stumpy invented legs. Central anterior pair in reconstruction are palps, not fifth walking pair or antennae.
Small anterior mouthparts conservative beneath head; eyes only restrained low relief consistent with reconstruction, not large spider-like bulbous eyes.
No exposed external tail, spinnerets, wings, scorpion pincers or spiny armor. Ventral pygidium is not a tail. Fine setae/ornament may be omitted at lowpoly scale.
restoration_boundaries: Actual carbonized holotype photo in2022Fig1D viewed; correct panelD only, not neighboring myriapodE. Caption identifies UlsterMuseumK25850 and500µm scale.
JNCCFigure2.44a gives interpreted dorsal/ventral fossil, b complete reconstruction fromDunlop1996. Real photo confirms body silhouette; reconstructed limbs supply missing functional anatomy.
Palaeotarbus is replacement name for Eotarbus jerami; do not confuse with the earlier Carboniferous taxon bearing Eotarbus name.
The original rounded abdomen and headshield gate is retained; limb stoutness must follow actual published reconstruction rather than exaggeration.
Body depth/color/pose inferred. No claim this is a scan or exact preserved whole animal.

scientific_limits.en: Original living reconstruction, not scan. Carnegie CM3392 mount includes substantial casts and sculpted restoration;2007 account reports only35% original bones and about25% newly sculpted. Head is checked against NPS adult skull cast; soft tissue, posture and missing parts remain inferred. Three metres is an approximate museum-mount display scale, not complete fossil measurement.
scientific_limits.zh: 完整活体美术复原，非扫描。Carnegie CM3392装架含大量翻模与雕塑补配，2007馆方说明原骨约35%、约25%新塑。头部另核NPS成年头骨翻模；软组织、姿态及缺失部分属推断。3米为约定展件尺度，非完整化石实测。

scale.basis: Carnegie2007 describes roughly10-foot mount; current NPS gives broad8-14foot estimates and2.4m smaller adult example. Three metres is approximate within that range.

diagnostic_targets: Slender extended neck joins small tapered beaked head to a moderately deep torso.
Long lightly built hindlimbs and narrow distal legs, distinct from stocky adult sauropodomorphs.
Short five-fingered forelimbs held free, no Iguanodon thumb spike.
Long tapering tail balances bipedal body; no horns, large predator teeth or armour.
Retain genuine neck/leg proportions versus compact short-necked Hypsilophodon, not size-only distinction.
frozen_scientific_scope.specimen_basis: Actual Carnegie mounted skeleton side photograph and official frontal photo inspected; NPS adult skull cast image with inch scale inspected. Current NPS species name D.elderae used, original genus scope preserved.

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole living Cymbospondylus petrinus, anchored to actual UCMP9950 axial skeleton and same-species UCMP9947 tail reconstruction. Composite scientific reconstruction with explicitly inferred terminal tail and soft tissues, not a complete single specimen scan.

scientific_limits.en: No named Cymbospondylus species is known from a complete skeleton. UCMP9950 preserves6.66m including skull1.14m, six anterior cervicals0.30m and remainder5.22m including first12caudals. UCMP9947 supplies a separate tail lacking base and tip. Published2024 combination is nearly10m before missing terminal tail, with11–12m considered plausible;11.5m model is an estimate. Skin, color, body volume, distal fin membranes and exact tail tip are inferred. The1925 illustration is a historical skeletal composite after Merriam, not a fossil photograph or complete measured soft outline. No anatomical substitution from giant C.youngorum or other ichthyosaurs.
scientific_limits.zh: 没有任何已命名杯椎鱼龙种具备完整骨架。UCMP9950保存6.66米，含头1.14、前六颈椎0.30及其余5.22米，后者含前12尾椎。另一个体UCMP9947尾段缺基部与尾尖；2024文组合近10米仍缺末端，认为11至12米合理，模型11.5米为推定。皮肤、颜色、体积、远端鳍膜与尾尖均推定。1925图为沿Merriam的历史骨架组合，不是真化石照片或实测软体轮廓；不移植youngorum等其他种。

original_scope.en: Planned animal asset: very long muscular trunk and a less deeply forked tail outline.
original_scope.zh: 规划中的动物资产：极长肌肉躯干与分叉较弱的尾轮廓。

evidence_anchors.actual_skeleton: Sander et al2024 FigS2 actual UCMP9950 photos, skull30cm ruler; cervical/postcranial tape in inches with postcranial tape extended48inches. Long serial ribcage/axial trunk is directly visible, not a tiny partial skull expanded without support.
evidence_anchors.scale: 2024 body-length reevaluation directly measures9950preserved6.66m; skull1.14m, sixcervicals0.30m, remainder5.22m. Addition of9947 tail3.33m gives nearly10m missing tip; authors consider11–12m plausible and note regression12.56m. Historical9.3m is not current actual whole measurement.
evidence_anchors.head: UCMP2016 actual9913 cranial photo supplementary same-species elongated low snout/pointed teeth; different individual with known variation, never called9950skull. Mainheadscale from9950S2.
evidence_anchors.tail: 2024 explicitly discusses elongate body with long relatively straight tail, not a later parvipelvian deepfork. UCMP9947 supplies caudal sequence with heightpeak near40thcaudal; exact terminal soft outline missing and inferred.
evidence_anchors.composite: Williston1925 Fig178 after Merriam gives historical skeletal arrangement and incomplete appendicular/tail regions. Reference only; do not copy missing appendages as amputations or label as a modern complete reconstruction.

scale.interpretation: Head length and preserved lengths are published actualmeasurements; full-length11.5m includes scaled second individual and reconstructedmissingtip. Other targets are conservative inferred volumes, not direct specimen caliper values; curvedpose boundingbox shorter than centerline.

morphology: Very long muscular but comparatively slender axial torso and long tapering tail; body is not a compact dolphin/Temnodontosaurus spindle. Broadly continuous elongated midsection with no exaggerated waist.

Relatively small low elongated head around10percent of restoredtotal, long straight tooth-bearing snout and small paired lateral eyes. Slightly open jaws5degrees or closed-with-visible marginalteeth; teeth modest pointed cones, not huge fangs.

Four distinct paired paddles attach to shoulder and pelvic regions, with muscular proximal transitions and modest rounded tapered distal membranes. Exact distal outlines inferred because complete limbs not preserved; do not invent clawed hands or wide modern turtle wings.

Long tail nearly half restored length, low compressed terminal profile and shallow inferred fin-like terminal expansion, not a strongly crescent or deeply forked tail. Keep continuous taper without detached fluke. Tailtip anatomy uncertain, no claim soft-tissue preservation.

No large dorsal fin is specified because this target lacks direct dorsalsofttissue evidence; conservative low dorsal contour is a reconstruction choice, not proof the animal lacked a fin. No sail, shell or bare vertebral ridges.

Neutral gray-brown skin with slightly lighter underside is inferred; do not color fossil cracks or include slab/supports. Modest lateral tailcurve allowed, not tight serpentine loop hiding the lengthgate.

shape_gate.required_combination: Very long muscular trunk plus long low-profile relatively unforked tail, whole animal with small elongate head and four paddles.
shape_gate.comparisons: Temnodontosaurus is deep compact-bodied with a much larger relative tooth-bearing skull and more pronounced inferred tail lobes. Ophthalmosaurus is compact fishlike with huge relativeorbit and strongly differentiated broadfore/smallhindfins. Cymbospondylus must have substantially elongated axialbody and long lowtail, not merely a resized clone or different pose.
acceptance: Lateral and perspective show long trunk and nearhalf-length tapering tail without a deep crescent fork.
Top shows narrowelongated body, smallrelativehead and four distinct pairedpaddles at correct regions.
No youngorum giant head substitute, no mixedothergenusfinshape or originalcompletefossilclaim.
Distal limbs/tail explicitly inferred; do not delete them to imitate fragmentary preservation or shrinkwhole scope.

diagnostic_targets: Complete low-slung furred animal with elongate narrow pointed snout and small inferred ears, not a duck bill or beaver incisors.
Broad elongated paddle tail compressed dorsoventrally: wide in top view, thin in side view; maximum width clearly exceeds pelvis. Tail is not vertically flattened or cylindrical otter tail.
Furred trunk with robust short outward-set forelimbs, visibly separate feet and modest claws, not seal flippers.
Spread hind toes linked by conservative partial webbing; retain toe silhouettes rather than solid oval feet.
Tail base furry, middle mostly fine scaled surface with sparse hair, distal margin some hair; simplify scales without literal large armored plates.
Semi-sprawling quadrupedal posture, coherent neck and limb joints; neutral original brown coloration not asserted fossil pigment.

frozen_scientific_scope.taxon: Stenodictya sp. (genus-level reconstruction anchored to S.lobata female holotype)

scale.uncertainty: Body length sums measured segments plus estimated prothorax; cerci full length and depth not preserved measurements. Use actual wing dimensions, not generic giant-insect maximum.

anatomy: Two large flight-wing pairs attached to meso/metathorax, widest near base then markedly narrowing in apical third. Hindwings slightly wider; major vein branches plus simplified crossvein network, not arbitrary dragonfly needles.
Paired cordate prothoracic lobes anterior to flight wings, about two-thirds forewing width, fan-like vein relief. These are small winglets, not a third equal flight pair or dorsal shield.
Small head with broad clypeal region, pair of eyes and antennae, forward/downward sucking beak with paired palps. Do not replace with chewing beetle mandibles.

Three thoracic segments with median grooves, robust sculpted dorsal cuticle; abdomen slightly broader than thorax, overlapping transverse tergites with modest pointed posterolateral corners and oblique strengthening ridges. No free gill paddles.
Three pairs of short articulated legs, five-part tarsal construction and tiny claws. Limbs arranged so wing bases do not hide every leg in all views.

Female-mode tail: pair of long tapering robust cerci and a modest separate curved ovipositor. Never add spinosa male claspers to lobata-based female. Cerci length and ovipositor distal completion explicitly inferred.
restoration_boundaries: Actual MNHN.F.R51415 museum photograph viewed, showing body and wings in slab; repository record gives lobata holotype and same taxonomic history as Brongniart22-1. Photo is real fossil, not reconstructed anatomy.
Kukalova1970 Fig51 and p12 fix lobata22-1 head, main wings, thorax, abdomen and female terminal bases. Published66×17.5mmforewing,39mmabdomen,7.8/7.2mmthorax.
Fig50 is explicitly a genus composite, NOT actual fossil: S.pygmaea winglet outline; S.oustaleti/S.agnita legs and five-segment tarsi; S.laurentiauxi beak.

Original author used other palaeodictyopterans to estimate incomplete structures: Eugereon palpal length, broader group labrum, Homaloneura ovipositor length. Keep these as approximate functional completion, not species diagnosis or directly measured lobata features.

Handlirsch/Sharov popular reconstructions were criticized in revision. Avoid dorsal shield mistaken from ventral view, broad untapered wings, exaggerated free abdominal gills and mixed male/female genitalia.
The model fulfills original complete genus-level gate; it does not assert a definitive modern phylogenetic interpretation of abdominal expansions. Color, body thickness and flight pose artistic.

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole living Ichthyosaurus somersetensis anchored to NHMUK PV OR2013 complete mounted skeleton and its measured cast dimensions, supplemented by same-species diagnostic cranial and paddle references. Not a scan or a literal fossil slab.

scientific_limits.en: OR2013 is behind glass; published2.68m total and47cm skull derive from its cast, not direct fresh measurement of original bones. Historical mount shows no evidence of a composite according to the author, but preservation and inaccessible areas limit certainty. NLMH106234 has an added tail and reconstructed fin elements; those are excluded as geometry evidence. Soft skin, body volume, dorsal fin, upper tail lobe, color and exact fin margins are inferred. Shared ichthyosaur outlines are not uniquely diagnostic; independent review must assess the anatomical combination, not name or scale alone.
scientific_limits.zh: OR2013原骨隔玻璃，发表总长2.68米与头47厘米测自铸型，不是新测原骨。作者未发现该历史架拼接证据，但保存及可接近性有限。补充标本NLMH106234尾部拼接且鳍有石膏补件，这些区不作几何证据。皮肤、体积、背鳍、尾上叶、颜色及鳍缘推定。鱼龙类共享轮廓并非独有诊断；独审须核结构组合而非仅改名称或大小。

scale.interpretation: Publishedcastmetricsabove retained; all otherdimensions modeled fromphotoandconservativeinference. Orbit targetscaled fromholotype9.6cm/47cmjaw context notsameindividualmeasurement. Do not equate skeletalorbit andvisibleeye.

morphology: Streamlined compact fishlike body with smooth rounded belly and a narrowtailstock; noextendedneck. Longnarrowrostrum occupies about65percentofskulllength and upper/lowerjaws endnearlytogether, not swordfishoverbite.
Smallregularpointed teeth alongbothjawmargins, retainedonadultmodel. Slightjawopening6degrees makesrowlegible without oversizedfangs. Approx30teethperjawside simplificationnotassertedactualcount.

Four distinct membranouspaddles. Forepair relativelybroadandrounded proximally,taperingtodistalpoint; hindpairnoticeablysmallerbutnotvestigial. Noexternalseparateddigits/claws orflatbonepolygons. PlasterreconstructedpartsinNLMHreferencearenottemplate.
Moderatemacroscopichead/eyeproportions; eye openingmuchsmallerthanbonyorbit. DonotinflateorbitintoOphthalmosauruslargeeyehead or makeLeptonectesneedlefins/snout.
Tailhasdownturnedbonyaxiswithinlowerlobe; inferredupperlobeformsverticalcrescenttail, neverhorizontalwhaleflukes. Modestsweptdorsalfininferred, not claimedpreservedinOR2013.
Mutedgray-blue dorsum andlightunderbody artisticinference; noembryo/cutaway/slab/ammonites ormountedbones onthelivinganimal. Allbodygeometryoriginal, notphototexturedfossil.

acceptance: Lateral showslongnarrowequaljawswithsmallteeth, compactbodyandverticaltail.
Top showsfourpaddleswithclearfore/hinddifferenceandnonneedleforepaddlechord.
Head-on/perspective showmoderateeyesandnarrowpairedjawswithoutgiantfangs.
Comparefrozennearestmodeldescriptors beforefinal; ifonlyscale/poseseparatesthem, reviseoriginalanatomicalcombinationratherthaninventinghorns/fins.

diagnostic_targets: Low long robust torso with short stout semi-erect limbs, not long-legged running dog or extremely sprawling lizard.
Large elongate heavy head with thick mandible and broad rear cheek/temporal volume; no tiny shrew head or modern blunt pug face.
Strong neck continuous with substantial shoulders, distinguish jaw depth from body mass.
Short broad plantigrade feet inferred from congener; small separated toes/claws, no hooves or flippers.
Long tapering cylindrical tail, not Castorocauda paddle or a modern badger short stump.
Neutral inferred fur and small rounded ears; no modern badger mask, striped back or asserted fossil coat pattern.

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete Triassic titanopteran insect anchored to nearly complete holotypePIN2240/4593 and Schubnel etal2021Fig6c reconstruction: long narrow segmented body, powerful spined grasping forelegs and two pairs of broad net-veined wings.

scientific_limits.en: Published2021Figure6a annotates97.62mm body length and12.33mm thorax width onPIN2240/4593. Missing distal appendages, antennae, three-dimensional depth, pose and color are reconstructed, not preserved measurements. Wing outline/leg topology followFig6c same-species interpretation. No claim of proven active flight or stridulation.
scientific_limits.zh: 2021论文图6a在PIN2240/4593标注体长97.62毫米、胸宽12.33毫米。缺失附肢末端、触角、厚度、姿态及颜色为复原而非保存实测。翅轮廓和足拓扑按图6c同种解释复原，不宣称已证实主动飞行或摩擦发声。

scale.uncertainty: 97.62/12.33mm are paper annotations on selected holotype. Spreadspan310mm and wing lengths estimated fromFig6c50mmbar, not popular400mmmaximum. Depth and limb subdivisions inferred.

anatomy: Long narrow body, defined head with paired eyes/mandibles and two slender antennae; distinct prothorax, mesothorax and metathorax, tapering segmented abdomen.

Powerful folded grasping foreleg pair attached anterior thorax: enlarged elongate femora with ventral spine row, opposed slimmer tibiae with small teeth and distal tarsi. Refer Fig6a F1/T1 rather than generic mantis overgrown prothorax.
Two other walking-leg pairs slender and articulated, each with distal tarsal/claw termination. Total three legpairs only, no insect limb substitution by wing supports.
Two pairs of elongated broad wings with rounded tips and comparatively reduced hindwing vannus. Do not give giant triangular grasshopper hindwing fans. Modest spread stance exposes all four wings.
Forewing middle zones enlarged with major longitudinal veins and restrained transverse irregular net cells. Hindwings simpler; no fabricated stridulatory file or opaque oversized sound organ.
Short paired terminal cerci conservatively restored, not Stenodictya enormous tail filaments; fossil fractures are not anatomical joints.
restoration_boundaries: ActualSupplementaryFig4photo shows nearly complete specimenwithforelegs,wings andmetricruler; viewed. SpeciesFile confirmsPIN2240/4593 asG.vulgaris holotype.
ActualFig6a explicitly traces body and labels97.62mm/12.33mm; Fig6c is theauthors complete reconstruction, not another fossil. Viewed both together toavoidbody/wing scale mixing.
Middle/rearlegs, distalforeleg endings, antennae and parts of head completed conservatively followingFig6c. No claim all are directly preserved inphoto.

2021paper finds comparatively smallhindwing area and questionsactiveflight; model isresting/displaypose, not proof of flying behavior. Wingcommunication remains interpretation, do notclaimcertainstridulation.
Typecatalog geographiclabelFergana/Uzbekistan differs modernMadygen locality descriptions; keep broadTriassicCentralAsia rather than resolving border/locality discrepancy without source.
Color,three-dimensionaldepth and exactspinecounts inferred. No copying reference meshes/textures.

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole living Platecarpus tympaniticus based on the articulated skeleton and partial soft tissues of LACM128319. Restore flesh over the complete animal, not a skull-only fossil, slab or transparent cutaway.

scientific_limits.en: LACM128319 preserves partial skin and body boundaries, not an entire intact living silhouette. Much tail skin was lost during collection/preparation. The natural ventral bend is skeletal evidence; the upper tail lobe size and exact outline are inferred.5.67m is reported skeletal length; flesh width, paddle margins, eye opening and colors are estimates. Putative color markings are not a complete established color scheme. Original slender-body wording must not be interpreted as an undifferentiated eel tail or extreme body thinness.
scientific_limits.zh: LACM128319保存部分皮肤与体缘，不是完整活体外轮廓；大量尾皮在采集制备中丢失。天然向下尾弯有骨骼证据，尾上叶大小及精确边界仍推定。5.67米是发表骨架长度，肉体宽度、鳍缘、眼裂及颜色估计。可能的色斑不代表已知完整配色。原细躯干用语不应变成无分区鳗尾或极端纤细躯干。

original_scope.en: Planned animal asset: shorter rounded head, slender trunk and downturned tail support.
original_scope.zh: 规划中的动物资产：较短圆头、纤细躯干与下弯尾支撑。

evidence_anchors.whole: Lindgren et al2010 Fig1 actual LACM128319 photographed in normal light,0.5m bar, nearly articulated skeleton across four separated slabs. Spaces between slabs not anatomical gaps. Text reports5.67m length.
evidence_anchors.head: Fig3 actual short rounded mosasaur skull/neck with scales and localized fleshy narial opening; fleshy nostril much smaller than bony opening. Cranial cavities are covered by flesh, not exposed.
evidence_anchors.tail: Fig6 actual wedge-shaped vertebrae and natural downturned tail segment,10cm detailed scale. Fig8A is skeletal reconstruction and Fig8B inferred body outline, explicitly unknown precise upper lobe shape/depth.
evidence_anchors.skin: Fig5 and text identify small rhomboidal overlapping body scales without obvious keels and variable head scales; low-poly simplification may omit microtexture. No large crocodilian scutes.
evidence_anchors.classification: 2010 anatomical referral of LACM128319 to P.tympaniticus is corroborated by Konishi et al2012 osteology publication abstract; do not replace with Plesioplatecarpus or Latoplatecarpus.

scale.interpretation: Only5.67m is a published whole skeletal measurement. Other targets are conservative estimates from photo and Fig8 reconstruction, not fresh caliper measurements. Total along bent tail axis differs from straight bounding box. Upper lobe is explicitly modeled inference and may be adjusted conservatively.

morphology: Short relatively rounded low mosasaur head with moderately tapered snout, not the long needle jaw of an ichthyosaur or toothless projecting Tylosaurus rostral tip. Modest temporal/cheek volume behind the eyes, no skull window holes.

Regular slightly recurved conical marginal teeth, no bulbous crushing molars or giant saber fangs. A modest10degree jaw opening reveals the tooth-bearing short head. Approx12 visible teeth per jaw side is simplified arrangement, not a measured exact dental formula.

Short neck blends into a streamlined elongated but substantial ribcage; no snake-thin trunk, belly must have real volume. The fleshy throat does not display tracheal rings or fossil organ traces externally.
Four short broad paddle limbs with fleshed rounded proximal connections and tapered ends; no land-lizard fingers or exposed bones. Fore and hind pairs are both conspicuous, hindpair slightly smaller.

Tail is regionalized: strong base, longer slimmer displacement segment, narrow peduncle, then a two-lobed vertical fin. Lower lobe follows the demonstrable downward vertebral bend. Upper lobe is conservative inferred tissue. No horizontal whale flukes, uniform eel tail, or unsupported dorsal body fin.

Smooth low-poly skin can imply tiny overlapping scales with restrained shading rather than heavy scutes. Muted brown-gray back and lighter ventrum are artistic inference, not claimed recovered whole coloration. No slab, ammonites or museum supports.

shape_gate.required_combination: Short rounded tooth-bearing head, streamlined elongated torso, four paddle limbs and naturally downturned tail support within a regionalized vertical caudal fin.
shape_gate.comparisons: Nothosaurus has a distinct longer neck, rostral constriction and webbed jointed limbs rather than compact mosasaur paddles. Ichthyosaurus has much longer narrow jaws and a dolphin-like compact body with inferred dorsal fin; this model must not be a fish-body clone. Within mosasaurs do not import Tylosaurus long toothless tip or Globidens spherical crushing crowns.
acceptance: Lateral and perspective show short rounded head, short neck and the downturned lower tail lobe.
Top clearly shows four broad paddles, substantial but elongated torso and narrower peduncle.
Tail carries separate muscular base and distal fin rather than an undifferentiated thin whip.
Upper lobe uncertainty remains explicit; no false claim a complete two-lobe soft-tissue outline survives.

description.en: {"representation":"living-reconstruction","scope":"Whole heavy low-bodied pyrothere with six projecting incisor tusks and a short proboscis concept, explicitly uncertain in soft-tissue length.","scientific_limits":{"en":"No complete articulated skeleton establishes whole-body proportions. ACM3207 skull and isolated limb measurements constrain an original reconstruction. Retracted nares and muscle attachments support a proboscis, but no preserved trunk determines its length. frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole heavy low-bodied pyrothere with six projecting incisor tusks and a short proboscis concept, explicitly uncertain in soft-tissue length.

scientific_limits.en: No complete articulated skeleton establishes whole-body proportions. ACM3207 skull and isolated limb measurements constrain an original reconstruction. Retracted nares and muscle attachments support a proboscis, but no preserved trunk determines its length. Billet2010 infers a very large trunk; this original short-proboscis concept is a transparent alternative soft-tissue choice, not demonstrated anatomy. Hands and distal feet are incompletely known; some historic attributed manus were later reassigned to astrapotheres. Coat, ears and tail inferred.
scientific_limits.zh: 无完整关联骨架可确定全体比例；以ACM3207真颅与孤立肢骨测量约束原创复原。后缩鼻孔及肌附着支持软鼻，但无保存鼻软组织能确定长度；Billet2010推断大发达鼻，本原目标短鼻concept为明确标注的另一软组织方案，不作实证。手与远端足不全，历史部分所谓手骨后来改归其他类群。皮肤、耳尾为推断。

frozen_scientific_scope.classification: Pyrotheria, Pyrotheriidae, Mammalia; precise higher affinities debated, not labeled an elephant

scale.source_status: Loomis1914 original measurements and cited Gaudry values, not one complete skeleton.
scale.model_status: Whole-body and soft-tissue dimensions are original estimates; trunk length explicitly uncertain, not measured.

diagnostic_targets: Massive deep elongated torso, low broad stance and stout limbs, not tall narrow modern elephant silhouette.
Elongate relatively narrow head with high retracted nasal region and short flexible proboscis concept above the tusk arcade.
Four upper incisor tusks in two bilateral pairs and two lower incisor tusks, projecting predominantly forward; do not reduce to two elephant tusks or invent canine sabers.
Upper incisors relatively straight/oblique with beveled tips, lower pair procumbent meeting upper arcade at acute angle, not warthog spirals.
Broad supporting plantigrade foot masses informed by genus tarsal study; no exact complete preserved digit-count claim.
Small inferred ears, restrained neutral skin and moderate tail; no African-elephant ears or rhino horn.

description.en: A whole-animal reconstruction of Homoioptera, with broad overlapping wings, small thoracic winglets and exceptionally long paired cerci. It combines same-species evidence; body depth, missing extremities and colour are interpretive.
description.zh: Homoioptera的完整活体复原，具有宽阔重叠的翅、小型前胸翼片与极长双尾须。综合同种证据制作，体厚、缺失末端和颜色为解释性补全。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete Carboniferous Homoioptera with broad subtriangular overlapping flight wings and small paired prothoracic winglets, long antennae, sucking beak, conspicuous palps and extremely long paired cerci. Anchored to real same-species fossil Fig2D–F in Brauckmann etal2010 and the original researcher whole-animal drawing published1989.

scientific_limits.en: Same-species interpretive reconstruction, not one perfectly preserved individual. 2010 authors report five near-complete specimens, wingspan about200mm and one incomplete cercus exceeding200mm. Body85mm and subdivisions estimated fromFig2E3cmbar;220mm cerci are conservative interpretation, not measured complete length. Figure2 specimen catalog number is unverified; do not assert a holotype or assign WMf.N.P.27205 without further evidence.
scientific_limits.zh: 同种解释复原，非单一完整保存个体。2010原研究者报告五个近完整标本、翼展约200毫米及一根未完整尾须保存超过200毫米。体长85毫米按图2E三厘米尺估计，尾须220毫米是保守补全而非完整实测。图2馆号未核实，不冒称模式或强行绑定WMf.N.P.27205。

scale.uncertainty: Body from sameFigure2E3cmbar; species wingspanapprox200mm. Cerci reported>200mm on one specimen; chosen220mm final taper interpretive, not exact preserved endpoint.1989caption total25cm is older reconstruction, not definitive adult total.

anatomy: Four broad subtriangular flight wings, fore/hind pairs considerably overlapping but separated vertically enough to read in views; widest proximal/middle and taper to rounded-pointed outer margins. No narrow Stenodictya-like wings.
Two small prothoracic lobes spread laterally ahead of flight wings, lightly pointed outward with fan-like venation. Not third full-sized flight wings.
Head with paired conspicuous compound eyes, long slender antennae, long central sucking beak and long leg-like maxillary palps. Palps are NOT a fourth walking-leg pair.
Three thoracic walking-leg pairs; articulated femur/tibia/tarsi, relatively short against large wings. Preserve distinct head appendage origins to separate palps from feet.
Segmented tapering abdomen with two extremely long articulated cerci, substantially longer than body and exceeding wingspan along arc. Use gentle divergence/curve without tangling silhouette.

Wing membranes lack observed color spots in this species, according2010. Subtle longitudinal veins and simplified branching/crossvein net; do not borrow woodwardi circular spots or gigantic gigantea size.
restoration_boundaries: Fig2D is actual fossil photograph; E interpreted tracing with damaged cerci and3cmbar; F head detail with0.5cmbar. All viewed, not generatedconcept.
Brauckmann1988drawing reproducedon1989p63 supplies complete posture and appendage arrangement, but old25cmtotalcaption is not used to override later>20cmcercus finding.

2010 same researchers describe five nearlycomplete specimens, long beak/palps/antennae, laterallyspread winglets, overlapping unspotted wings and extreme venational variability. Exact vein count is not artificially fixed asspeciesdiagnosis.
Selected restoration is same-species synthesis; no woodwardi body from onlywing specimen, no gigantea scale, no uncertain museumID claims.
Terminal sex-specific structures omitted rather than combining femaleovipositor with maleclaspers; individual sex not asserted. Longpairedcerci remain.
Depth, living posture, missingdistalextremities and color areinterpretive. No reconstructedairbreathingorgans shown externally.

description.en: A robust hadrosaur reconstruction with a strongly arched nasal hump and otherwise uncrested skull. Missing anatomy, soft tissues, colour and pose are inferred rather than a scan of one complete individual.
description.zh: 完整鸭嘴龙类复原，鼻部明显隆起，头骨其余部分无冠。缺失解剖结构、软组织、颜色与姿态为推断，并非单个完整标本的扫描。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole robust hadrosaur with strongly arched nasal hump on an otherwise uncrested skull; original inventory target maintained.

scientific_limits.en: Artistic whole-animal reconstruction using an exhibited skeletal mount and skull morphology described for RAM6797. The holotype lacks most of its right skull side; complete animal combines inferred missing parts and soft tissue. Photo of Utah mount does not establish its accession or original-bone percentage. Twelve metres is the museum species maximum estimate, not measured specimen length. Colour, skin and pose inferred.
scientific_limits.zh: 根据博物馆装架及RAM6797描述的头骨形态进行完整活体美术复原。正模缺大部分右侧头骨，完整体包含缺失部位及软组织推断。Utah装架照片不证明其馆藏号或真骨比例。12米为馆方物种最大尺度估计，不是该标本实测；颜色、皮肤与姿态属推断。

scale.basis: NHMU species profile estimated upper size, not individual measurement.

diagnostic_targets: Prominent smoothly arched nasal hump anterior to eyes, rising above frontal level.
Very deep robust skull and jaw with steeply ascending anterior beak; not flat Edmontosaurus profile.
No tube, helmet or rear head crest; hump is nasal and continuous with snout.
Heavy trunk, short forelimbs, larger hindlimbs, long tapering tail; complete neutral quadrupedal animal.
Slightly downturned lower jaw anterior end; closed mouth simplifies tooth batteries without claiming toothless jaws.
frozen_scientific_scope.specimen_basis: Actual Utah mounted skeleton photo and Alf Museum exhibited skull photo viewed. Primary Gates and Sampson2007 describes RAM6797, missing right side, high nasal arch and deep robust skull; no assumption exhibited skull is all original material.

description.en: A living reconstruction of Plesiosaurus dolichodeirus with a small head, long neck, broad body and four flippers. The holotype anchors the model, but soft tissues, flipper margins and colour are inferred.
description.zh: Plesiosaurus dolichodeirus的活体复原，呈现小头、长颈、宽躯与四鳍肢。以正模为依据，软组织、鳍缘及颜色为推断。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole living Plesiosaurus dolichodeirus, principally based on the holotype NHMUK PV OR22656. Flesh covers the small head, long neck, broad ribcage, four flippers and relatively short tail. Not a fossil slab or skull-only asset.

scientific_limits.en: The holotype photo shows actual bones with crushing, displaced cervical elements and incomplete/disarticulated paddle details; it is not an intact soft-tissue outline.3.1m is Paul's published estimated total length for specimen22656, not a fresh direct measurement. The table misspells dolichodeirus and abbreviates the institution NMH; accession22656 and specimen context identify the intended holotype. NHM's generic around3.5m statement is not assigned to this individual. Neck/torso flesh, paddle margins, tail skin, eyes and colors are inferred. Neck functional evidence from other plesiosaur genera is used only to justify a conservative near-straight pose, not species-specific joint measurements.
scientific_limits.zh: 真标本照片存在压扁、颈椎移位及部分鳍肢细节散乱，不是完整软组织轮廓。3.1米为Paul对22656标本的发表估计全长，并非新实测；表内种名拼写及NMH缩写有笔误，以标本号与语境对应正模。NHM约3.5米的属级介绍不当作该个体实测。肉体、鳍缘、尾皮、眼与配色推定。其他蛇颈龙属的颈功能研究仅辅助保守近直姿态，不冒充本种关节测量。

original_scope.en: Planned animal asset: small head on a long neck above a broad four-flipper body.
original_scope.zh: 规划中的动物资产：长颈小头与宽四鳍肢躯干。

evidence_anchors.whole: The paleobear2017 actual NHM holotype photograph: small skull at right, long cervical chain, broad ribcage, four paddle skeletons, short tapering caudal series at left. Some cervical and limb bones are displaced; do not reproduce fossil breaks as anatomical gaps. NHM museum article identifies this specimen as the Mary Anning holotype.
evidence_anchors.scale: Paul Sea Reptile Masses and Dimensions, p2: Plesiosaurus dolichoderius NMH22656 estimated3.1m; OXFUM J.10304 is separate3.4m specimen and not used. Actual table page visually checked.
evidence_anchors.classification: Storrs1997 publisher search-index abstract restricts Plesiosaurus to dolichodeirus and junior synonyms, notes nonspatulate symphysis,~40cervicals and slightly longer forelimbs. Full chapter403 unavailable, not claimed read. Do not import former Plesiosaurus species now Seeleyosaurus/Meyerasaurus.
evidence_anchors.pose: Noe,Taylor,Gomez-Perez2017 original article read. Its empirical exemplars are Muraenosaurus,Cryptoclidus,Tricleidus, NOT this holotype. Group-level osteological discussion supports conservative low-curvature neck instead of swanlike vertical S; feeding hypothesis not treated as established for this species.

scale.interpretation: 3.1m is an author-published reconstruction estimate. All component dimensions above are modeling estimates constrained by the skeleton, not independent caliper readings. Neck is near the combined trunk+tail length; skull distinctly small. Flattened slab width is not literal living depth. Maintain plausible fleshed volume and allow modest adjustment rather than fake measurement precision.

morphology: Small narrow low head with gently tapered snout and rear cranial volume, not a broad pliosaur head, ichthyosaur needle rostrum or crocodilian bulbous spatulate muzzle. Modest8degree jaw opening can show small slender pointed teeth;~20perjawside is simplified representation, not an exact dental count.

Long cylindrical but gently tapering fleshed neck, substantially longer than trunk and about the trunk+tail length. Base broadens into shoulder. Keep nearly horizontal with only gentle ventral/lateral curvature, no swan S, cobra hood or disconnected beads.
Broad oval trunk with substantial rounded flank and ventrum, distinctly broader than the neck. Avoid either a thin ribbon or a spherical turtle shell. No external ribs, girdle holes or slab.

Four conspicuous elongate hydrofoil flippers, both pairs similarly substantial with forepair slightly longer. Narrow tapering rounded tips and fleshed roots; no separated land fingers or claws. Preserve negative spaces between anterior and posterior pairs.

Relatively short tapering tail, distinctly shorter than neck. No giant ichthyosaur/mosasaur crescent fin or dolphin flukes. A simple conservative tapered terminal outline is not proof that every small soft-tissue fringe was absent.
Muted gray-green dorsal and lighter ventral color is artistic inference. No speculative armor, dorsal body fin, crocodilian scales or conspicuous fixed skin pattern.

shape_gate.required_combination: Very small head, long neck around trunk+tail length, broad oval torso and four similarly substantial hydrofoil flippers. The combination must read independently of label/color/scale/pose.
shape_gate.comparisons: Nothosaurus has much shorter neck relative to trunk and tail, conspicuous elongated constricted fang-bearing head, jointed partly webbed limbs and long tapering tail. Simosaurus has a broader blunt head and relatively shorter neck. Platecarpus has short neck, mosasaur head and a long regionalized downturned caudal fin; it is not a plesiosaur body.
acceptance: Lateral front and perspective retain small head and long gently curved neck without swan posture.
Top reveals broad oval torso and four separate well-spaced elongate hydrofoils, both pairs substantial.
Tail is short relative to neck; no whale flukes or fishlike caudal fin.
Model remains whole living animal, with no fossil gaps, exposed bones or unsupported elaborate skin ornament.

description.en: A whole pampathere reconstruction with a broad armoured back, three flexible central bands and a long narrow head. Body scale and soft tissues are estimates, not measurements of one complete individual.
description.zh: 完整活体复原，呈现宽阔背甲、三条中央活动甲带与狭长头部。全身尺度和软组织为复原估计，不是单个完整个体的实测。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole living large pampathere with broad armored back, three flexible central bands and long narrow head.

scientific_limits.en: UF890 partial skull dimensions do not measure a whole living individual; premaxillae, zygomatic arches and parts of occiput/ventral skull are missing. Whole body scale and soft tissues are reconstruction estimates. Museum mount restoration extent unknown. LPP-PV-001 H.cryptae skeleton is comparative only: 2025 osteoderm study questions its generic placement and calls for cranial reassessment, not a confirmed transfer. Do not combine its measured 2.2m axial length with UF890 as one specimen. Skin color, ears and exact toe soft tissue inferred.
scientific_limits.zh: UF890部分颅实测不是完整活体尺寸，前颌、颧弓及部分枕/腹面缺失。全体比例和软组织为复原估计，展架修复程度不明。LPP-PV-001 cryptae仅比较；2025甲片研究对其属归属提出疑问并要求颅骨复核，不是已确定改属。其2.2米轴长不与UF890合称同个体实测。颜色、耳和趾软组织为推断。

scale.species_report: University of Florida1997 reports H.septentrionalis more than6ft long, a species estimate.
scale.model_status: All model dimensions original estimates, not same-specimen measurements; total2.2m not adopted as H.cryptae measurement.

diagnostic_targets: Long relatively narrow tapering head, low triangular snout, small eyes and cephalic armor; not blunt glyptodont face or anteater tube.
Broad elongated moderately domed carapace formed by distinct shoulder and pelvic bucklers, not one spherical turtle shell.
Exactly three transverse movable central bands between bucklers; distinguish boundary semimovable rows from those three bands.
Polygonal buckler scutes with raised central regions and depressed perimeter, elongated rectangular overlapping band scutes. Low-poly grouped geometry not hundreds of separate blocks.
Four sturdy short clawed limbs, feet below side armor with clear ground contact; no hooves or flippers.
Tapering armored tail without a club or spikes; neutral inferred skin and tiny ears, no glyptodont giant ball shell.

description.en: A complete Sphecoptera reconstruction with four narrow wings and long paired tail filaments. Based on an incomplete compression fossil, it infers body depth and missing appendage details; original colour and sex are unknown.
description.zh: Sphecoptera的完整复原，具有四片狭长翅与长双尾丝。依据不完整压印化石，体厚和缺失附肢细节为推断，原色与性别未知。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete Carboniferous insect with four narrow, long-petioled wings, slender segmented abdomen and long paired tail filaments. Anchor: MNHN.F.R51337 lectotype, not the differently named single-wing species S. brongniartiana.

scientific_limits.en: Interpretive living restoration of an incomplete compression fossil. Body38mm and wingspan100mm are approximate image estimates from the centimeter ruler in the same specimen ethanol photo, not published caliper measurements. Cerci35mm each include conservative missing-end completion; depth, antennae and incompletely visible walking legs are inferred. Original hues and sex are unknown. No hovering performance is experimentally demonstrated by this model.
scientific_limits.zh: 不完整压印化石的活体解释复原。体长38毫米、展翅100毫米来自同标本乙醇照片厘米尺估计，非论文卡尺实测；双尾各35毫米包含保守缺失末端补配。体厚、触角和不清晰步足为推断，原色及性别未知，模型不证明实际悬停性能。

scale.uncertainty: Approximately15percent on planar image measurements. Wet photo ruler ticks about73pixels per centimeter at800px width; head to abdominal tip roughly270px, crosswingextent roughly720px. Cerci preserved beyond abdominal tip roughly200px;35mm chosen conservative tapered completion. No precision claim.

anatomy: Four elongated wings in two thoracic pairs. Proximal portion narrow and stalk-like, broaden toward outer middle then rounded distal ends; preserve open gaps between pairs.
Slim thorax and distinctly segmented slender abdomen; no dragonfly-thick body, no wasp waist and no extra pair of prothoracic winglets borrowed from Homoioptera.
Paired very long slender cerci from posterior abdominal tip, slightly diverging; do not add a third mayfly tail filament.
Three pairs of small articulated walking legs; these are conservative group-level completions, not six fully preserved limbs claimed in the specimen.
Small head, paired modest eyes, short conservative antennae and small ventral sucking rostrum. Fine mouthparts are not asserted as visible in the photo.

Use low-contrast alternating dark/light wing patches matching the major observed pattern; original colors unknown. Simplify venation into sparse longitudinal branching, not dense invented diagnostic counts.
restoration_boundaries: MNHN catalog explicitly identifies R51337 as lectotype and incomplete; retain both facts. Public exhibit image matches distinctive slab cracks and explains newly exposed left wing ends and cerci.
Catalog ethanol photo with centimeter ruler is size anchor; public exhibit closeup gives clearer silhouette and patch pattern, without an independent scale.
Do not mix brongniartiana R51307, a separate single-wing species, or other Sphecoptera species. No claim they are synonyms.
Planar wing outline, body and long paired cerci observed; living depth, postural symmetry, missing distal appendages and exact endpoint lengths inferred. No exact sex-specific terminalia.
Museum interpretation of paleopterous spread wings is used for posture; hovering and disruptive camouflage remain interpretation, not directly demonstrated physiology.

description.en: An adult-scale Camarasaurus reconstruction with a short boxy skull, stout neck and near-level shoulders and hips. This is a composite artistic reconstruction, not a scan of one individual; soft tissues and posture are inferred.
description.zh: 成年尺度的Camarasaurus复原，具有短方头骨、粗壮颈部与近水平的肩臀轮廓。属于综合美术复原，非单个体扫描；软组织与姿态为推断。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete adult genus-level sauropod reconstruction retaining short boxy skull, stout neck and near-level shoulder-hip line. Not a long-snouted diplodocid or high-shouldered brachiosaur.

scientific_limits.en: Adult-scale artistic reconstruction, not a scan of one individual. Adult skull CM12020 informs head shape; the illustrated Smithsonian body mount combines subadult USNM13786, separate tail USNM15492 and skull cast USNM369928 from DINO28. Do not treat juvenile CM11338 as an adult or copy the Apatosaurus body in panelD. Fifteen metres is a genus estimate, not a specimen measurement. Neck posture, soft tissue and colour inferred.
scientific_limits.zh: 成年尺度的属级完整美术复原，不是单一个体扫描。成年颅骨CM12020支持头形；史密森身体装架为亚成体USNM13786、不同个体尾部USNM15492及来自DINO28的颅模USNM369928拼合。不得把幼体CM11338当成年，也不得复制D图雷龙类Apatosaurus身体。15米为属级估值，非标本实测。颈姿态、软组织及颜色属推断。

scale.basis: NHMU genus estimate15–20m, use lower end; no scaled juvenile measurement claim.

diagnostic_targets: Short deep boxy head with blunt rounded muzzle, not tapering long diplodocid skull.
Stout relatively compact neck, not Mamenchisaurus-like hyperelongation.
Broad ribcage, four weight-bearing columnar limbs; front limbs slightly shorter than hind limbs.
Near-level shoulder and hip line without elevated brachiosaur shoulder tower.
Complete tapering tail of moderate relative length; no spikes or armor.
frozen_scientific_scope.specimen_basis: Actually viewed NPS2021Fig1; adult CM12020 skull panelE, composite subadult skeleton panelsB/C, juvenile panelA clearly separated; panelD is Apatosaurus body wearing historical wrong skull and excluded.

reference_credits.title: Fantastic Camarasauruses and Where to Find Them, ReBecca Hunt-Foster2021
Camarasaurus, Natural History Museum of Utah

description.en: A complete living trilobite reconstruction with fourteen thoracic segments, a small tail shield and paired branched limbs. Body depth, missing limb tips and some appendage arrangements are inferred; fossil pyrite colour is not evidence of living colour.
description.zh: 完整三叶虫活体复原，具有十四节胸部、小尾盾和成对分支附肢。体厚、缺失足端及部分附肢安排为推断；化石的黄铁矿金色不代表活体颜色。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete living trilobite with rounded cephalon, fourteen articulated thoracic segments, small pygidium, paired antennae and visible repeated walking-leg/gill branches. Same-species synthesis anchored to YPM219 actual ventral fossil photograph, Treatise whole-body diagram and modern T.eatoni limb research.

scientific_limits.en: Body27mm is estimated from the10mm bar on the Treatise reconstruction in Casey/Lieberman Fig7A, NOT a measured size of YPM219 shown separately in Fig7B. Depth, posture and missing limb tips are inferred; pygidial limb count is a simplified reconstruction. Hou2021 Fig4C is a proposed T.eatoni articulation; direct body-wall junction evidence there comes from Olenoides, not proof that the same junction is preserved in Triarthrus. Living color unknown; pyrite gold is mineralization.
scientific_limits.zh: 体长27毫米按Casey/Lieberman图7A中Treatise复原图的10毫米尺估计，不是右侧图7B标本YPM219的实测。体厚姿态与缺失足端为推断，尾板足数为简化复原。Hou2021图4C是同种附肢连接假说，体壁连接直接实证来自Olenoides，不冒称Triarthrus已保存。活体颜色未知，金色为黄铁矿矿化。

scale.uncertainty: About15percent planar reconstruction estimate. Fig7A10mmbar approx157px and bodyapprox427px at rendered1041pxpage; do not apply this bar to separate photo7B.

anatomy: Broad rounded cephalon with raised central glabella and paired modest lateral eyes; narrow axial lobe continues along segmented trunk. Do not use giant genal spines.
Fourteen discrete thoracic tergites, repeated axial rings and lateral pleurae, followed by a small rounded pygidium. Preserve articulation gaps rather than one smooth shell.

One pair of forward slender segmented antennae. Three pairs of post-antennal cephalic biramous appendages, fourteen thoracic pairs, and four progressively tiny pygidial pairs as schematic completion. Pygidial count is not claimed measured in YPM219.
Each repeated biramous limb has a lower jointed walking branch and an upper shaft carrying a comb of short gill filaments. Gills stay under pleurae above walking legs, not giant external fins.
Walking branches extend modestly beyond shell margins for readable side silhouette; add terminal tapered claws and simplify proximal feeding spines. No swimming paddle substitution.
Use restrained matte earthy cuticle. Actual photographed gold is pyrite and must not be described as living coloration. Gill shade may be slightly lighter for readability, not a fossil color claim.
restoration_boundaries: YPM219 is actual photo7B from Yale collection credited to Bruce Lieberman; source spells Triarthus but intended taxon is Triarthrus eatoni. Photo itself has no scale.
Treatise diagram7A supplies whole dorsal/ventral arrangement,14thoracicsegments and10mmbar; not claimed same specimen219 or one pristine individual.
Hou,Hughes,Hopkins2021 real T.eatoni micrographs support filament-bearing upper branch; Fig4C gives explicit proposed same-species structure. Do not copy Fig4B Olenoides body shape.
Filament cross-section and blood channels are microscopic scientific findings, not colored visible tubes on outer model. Simplify to comb-like blades.
Three-dimensional depth, restored symmetry and appendage posture interpretive. No egg cluster, sex-specific structures or inferred reproductive claim added.

reference_credits.title: Casey and Lieberman, Introduction to the Trilobites: Morphology, Macroevolution and More, Fig7
Hou,Hughes,Hopkins2021, The trilobite upper limb branch is a well-developed gill, Science Advances7:eabe7377

description.en: A living reconstruction of Cryptoclidus eurymerus, with a rounded torso and four broad flippers. It combines same-species material rather than reproducing one specimen; soft tissues, proportions and colour are inferred.
description.zh: Cryptoclidus eurymerus的活体复原，具有圆厚躯干与四片宽鳍肢。综合同种材料而非复制单个标本，软组织、细分比例与颜色为推断。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole living Cryptoclidus eurymerus. Original asset ID cryptocleidus is retained; Cryptoclidus is the scientific spelling. Reconstruct head, neck, rounded torso, four broad hydrofoil limbs and tail, not a skull-only asset or museum mount.

scientific_limits.en: The Paris complete skeletal mount is a fossil-based museum assembly with restoration/cast components; skull surface clearly includes reconstruction. Its accession and exact restored fraction are not established here. Do not call every visible surface original bone, or treat museum pose as live posture. Paul's5.5m estimate belongs to separate NHM R8575, NOT the photographed Paris individual and NOT neotype R2860. This is a species-level multi-source living reconstruction, not a measured digital twin of one specimen. Soft tissue margins, body volume, color and precise proportions are estimates. Broad skull means a broad posterior triangular outline with a tapered snout, not an enlarged pliosaur head.
scientific_limits.zh: 巴黎完整骨架为含修复/翻模构件的馆藏装架，头骨表面明显有复原；本次未核定该展架馆藏号和修复比例，不把所有可见表面冒充原骨或装架姿态当活体姿态。Paul的5.5米估计属于另一NHM R8575，不是巴黎对象或新模R2860实测。本模型为同种多材料活体复原，不是单标本数字孪生。软组织、体积、配色及细分比例推定；宽头指后部较宽的三角轮廓，不能扩成巨型上龙头。

original_scope.en: Planned animal asset: relatively broad skull and broad paddles framing a rounded torso.
original_scope.zh: 规划中的动物资产：较宽头骨、宽鳍肢与圆躯干。

evidence_anchors.whole: Ghedoghedo2013 Paris MNHN complete museum skeletal mount photograph actually viewed. Broad rib basket and four substantial paddle skeletons visible. Museum2024 article independently identifies displayed fossil as C.eurymerus. No claim of known accession or original/restored bone map.
evidence_anchors.head: Same photographer's skull closeup viewed: high posterior skull, large orbit and tapering snout; pale reconstructed surface warns against using it as original fine osteology. Noe et al2017 p142 explicitly describes Cryptoclidus as relatively broad subtriangular dorsally, relatively high posteriorly and more pointed snout than Muraenosaurus. Fig4 depicts Muraenosaurus, NOT this taxon and must not be copied.
evidence_anchors.proportion: Noe et al2017 p144 states Cryptoclidus skull about one-quarter of neck length and notes ontogenetic variation. This supports shorter relative neck/larger relative head than selected Plesiosaurus comparator, without claiming every individual identical.
evidence_anchors.scale: Paul size table p2 explicitly lists Cryptoclidus eurymerus NHM R8575 estimated5.5m. Used as author-published large-individual species scale only. Noe and Paris anatomy sources are different material; do not assign5.5m to the Paris display.
evidence_anchors.classification: MNHN scientific taxon record gives Cryptoclidus eurymerus (Phillips1871). Original ID cryptocleidus stable. Former Muraenosaurus/Cryptoclidus oxoniensis references in older anatomical literature do not create a separate production ID.

scale.scale_specimen: NHM R8575, separate from Paris photographic mount
scale.interpretation: 5.5m is a published estimate, not a measurement of the photographed individual. All component targets are inferred and sum along the body axis; do not imply exact preservation. Head/neck=0.25 follows published genus proportions. Round torso and broad hydrofoils are fleshed estimates supported by the mounted rib cage/limb structure; preserve scientific silhouette rather than inflate for difference.

morphology: Relatively broad subtriangular head in top view, wider posteriorly and tapering into a moderately pointed snout; high rounded rear cranial region. Large orbit covered by flesh, no open temporal holes. Head remains small compared with trunk, not a pliosaur predator head.

Slender gently curved pointed marginal teeth, not large serrated cutting teeth. Noe2017 warns that supposedly carinate Cryptoclidus teeth were actually associated metriorhynchid crocodilian teeth; never import these. Use modest8degree jaw opening and simplified~20visibleteethperjawside, not a measured complete dental formula.

Neck long but not exaggerated: about four head lengths, around one-third total length, near-straight with gentle low curvature and a thickening base. Do not reuse the much smaller-headed, proportionally longer-necked Plesiosaurus outline or make a swan S.

Broad rounded oval trunk with deep fleshed ribcage and slightly flattened ventral surface, not a spherical shell or narrow fish torso. Smooth shoulder and hip transitions retain a broad powered swimming body.

Four substantial broad hydrofoil flippers, both pairs clearly visible and of comparable size. Broad proximal/midsection and rounded tapering tip; no land digits, claws or giant thin triangular wings. Maintain separation between both flipper pairs in top and perspective views.

Tail is tapering and shorter than neck, with no unsupported giant fishlike crescent, whale flukes or exaggerated whip. A plain conservative tail skin outline does not prove small soft-tissue fins absent.
Muted blue-gray/dark olive back and pale ventrum are artistic inference, no claimed fossil color. No museum rods, slab, skeletal windows, crocodile scutes or dorsal body fin.

shape_gate.required_combination: Relatively broad posterior triangular head, broad substantial four paddles framing a rounded torso; head/neck about1:4 and less extremely long-necked than Plesiosaurus. Keep original whole-body gate.
shape_gate.comparisons: Plesiosaurus frozen comparator has a much smaller relative head and neck around46%total, slimmer flipper chord:length~0.34. Here head is about9%total, neck~36%, broad flipper chord:length~0.42 and substantial rounded trunk. These targets are modeling interpretations anchored to genus evidence, not species-diagnostic measurements. Nothosaurus has constricted fanged head, much shorter neck, jointed webbed limbs and long tail. Platecarpus has short neck and regionalized caudal fin. Do not achieve distinction by color, size or pose alone.
acceptance: Top shows posteriorly broad triangular head and broad four hydrofoil paddles around a rounded torso.
Lateral front shows high posterior head and substantial ribcage, with neck about four head lengths.
Perspective and head-on keep negative spaces between limbs and visibly volumetric torso.
Compare with frozen Plesiosaurus descriptor at normalized length; do not pass an enlarged clone.

description.en: A rail-like bird reconstruction with long walking legs, a slightly hooked bill and an elongated feathered tail. The width of the closed tail, feather volume and colour remain interpretive.
description.zh: 秧鸡状鸟类的完整复原，具有长步行腿、微钩短喙与修长羽尾。闭合尾扇宽度、羽量和颜色仍属解释性复原。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole living rail-like bird with long walking legs, a short pointed slightly hooked bill and broad elongated feathered tail.

scientific_limits.en: SMF ME3550 is an articulated flattened specimen, not a volumetric body scan. Measured tibiotarsus and tarsometatarsus constrain legs; 30cm is a museum species-level size estimate, not an exact individual dimension. Feather preservation is usually poor; tail length supported, broad closed fan and plumage volume are original reconstruction. No proven color or extravagant crest. The historical sunbittern affinity is not adopted as current taxonomy.
scientific_limits.zh: SMF ME3550为压扁关联骨架，非全体体积扫描。胫跗骨及跗跖骨实测约束腿长，30厘米为官方种级估计非该个体实测。羽保存一般较差，长尾有证据，宽闭合扇尾及羽量为原创复原。颜色与夸张头冠无实证；不采用旧太阳鸟亲缘假说为现行分类。

frozen_scientific_scope.classification: Aves, Gruiformes, Messelornithidae; relative of rails/finfoots, not modern sunbittern

scale.measurement_source: Morlo2004 actual specimen, inferred male among largest individuals.
scale.model_status: Whole dimensions and fleshed proportions original estimates; leg bone measurements retained separately.

diagnostic_targets: Small compact rail-like trunk elevated on long slim but weight-bearing walking legs, not tiny crouched duck legs.
Short narrow tapering bill with modest downhook at very tip, not long heron spear or deep parrot/terrorbird hook.
Moderate curved neck and small rounded head; no cassowary helmet or elaborate invented crest.
Conspicuous elongated broad overlapping feather tail, not tiny upright modern rail stub or bony dinosaur tail.
Two modest folded feather wings and neutral plumage, clearly feathered body rather than bare skeleton.
Three forward toes and rear hallux with modest claws; terrestrial nonwebbed feet, balanced stance. Toe soft-tissue reconstruction from bird comparisons.

reference_credits.title: Messelornis cristata fossil profile
Diet of Messelornis (Aves: Gruiformes), an Eocene bird from Germany
New material of Paleocene-Eocene Pellornis clarifies gruiform radiation

description.en: A complete early sauropodomorph reconstruction with a heavy low body, broad supporting stance, long neck and tapering tail. Mounted skeletons inform the form, but soft tissues, body width and living posture are inferred.
description.zh: 早期蜥脚形类完整复原，具有低而厚重的躯干、宽支撑肢态、长颈和渐细长尾。装架骨骼提供形态参考，软组织、体宽与活体姿态为推断。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete early sauropodomorph retaining original low heavy-bodied trunk with broad supporting limb stance, long neck and complete tapering tail. Not a renamed gracile bipedal Massospondylus.

scientific_limits.en: Whole-animal artistic reconstruction, not one specimen scan. Actually viewed Ortiz et al.2025 Fig6.4 original museum skeleton mount and Fig9.3 newer replica mount; their restored portions and posture are not all original anatomy. Tail cropped in Fig6.4, complete replica silhouette informs missing span. Copenhagen skull is a cast with unverified accession, not an independently verified holotype skull. Length5.2m is NHM estimate, not measured from these photos. Body width, muscles, skin, colour and life pose inferred. Broad stance means stable supporting placement, not reptile-like sprawling limbs.
scientific_limits.zh: 完整活体美术复原，非单标本扫描。已实看Ortiz等2025图6.4真实旧骨架装架及图9.3新复制装架；补配部分和装架姿势不均等于原位解剖。图6.4尾端裁切，完整复制装架仅辅助尾轮廓。哥本哈根头骨为未核馆藏编号的铸模，不宣称独立核实了正模颅骨。5.2米来自NHM估值，非照片实测。躯体宽度、肌肉、皮肤颜色与活体姿态属推断。宽支撑肢态不等于爬行动物式横向匍匐。

scale.basis: Natural History Museum Dino Directory genus estimate; not10m, not specimen measurement.

diagnostic_targets: Deep heavy ribcage/abdomen and relatively low body carried between four robust supporting limbs.
Long neck with small elongate sloping skull, not boxy Camarasaurus head.
Broad stable support footprint without extreme sprawling shoulders/elbows.
Complete long gradually tapering tail with strong base, no spikes or tail club.
All four robust limbs readable, trunk not reduced to a thin bipedal cursor silhouette.
frozen_scientific_scope.specimen_basis: Ortiz et al.2025 Fig6.4 old original-bone mount, Fig9.3 new replica; Table2 names holotypePVL3808 but captions do not explicitly identify mount accession. Copenhagen skull cast photo identified at genus level.

reference_credits.title: Ortiz et al.2025, The Colección Paleontología de Vertebrados Lillo, a pioneering role in the research on fossil vertebrates in Argentina
Riojasaurus, Natural History Museum Dino Directory
Riojasaurus skull cast, Copenhagen, FunkMonk2010

description.en: A whole Tylosaurus proriger reconstruction with four paddles and a swimming tail. It combines multiple sources; soft tissues, paddle edges, tail-fin shape and colour are inferred rather than preserved together in one specimen.
description.zh: Tylosaurus proriger的完整复原，具有四桨肢与游泳尾。综合多项材料，软组织、桨缘、尾鳍外形和颜色为推断，并非同一标本共同保存。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole living Tylosaurus proriger, retaining original genus ID and complete head, trunk, four paddles and swimming tail. Species-level multi-material reconstruction, not a single-specimen digital twin.

scientific_limits.en: USNM8898 about9m is a published estimate in Everhart2006p178, not a direct measurement of the photograph. Smithsonian photo metadata identifies T.proriger with plesiosaur stomach contents, consistent with8898, but accession is not legible in photo: association is an inference, not proven label reading. Mounted skeleton includes restoration and pose distortion; do not copy its arched back or upturned tail. CMN8162 is a separate subadult skull with negatively allometric rostrum, so its42mm rostrum is NOT directly scaled into an adult measurement. Soft tissue, paddle outlines, caudal fin, body volumes and color inferred. 2018 table8898 skull710mm conflicts with other apparent size cues and is excluded from metric authority. Giant Bunker/Sophie material reassigned T.rex2026 is excluded.
scientific_limits.zh: USNM8898约9米是Everhart2006第178页文献估计，不是照片实测。Smithsonian图说明为胃含蛇颈龙的T.proriger，与8898相符，但图中馆藏号不可读，关联仅推断。展架有修复和姿态扭曲，不复制拱背和上翘尾。CMN8162是另一亚成年头骨，吻端负异速生长，42毫米不能直接放大成成体测量。软组织、桨肢轮廓、尾鳍、体积和颜色推定。2018表中8898头长710毫米有矛盾，排除量尺用途。2026改定T.rex的Bunker/Sophie巨型材料不用。

original_scope.en: Planned animal asset: elongate toothless rostral tip preceding the toothed jaws.
original_scope.zh: 规划中的动物资产：有齿颌前方延伸的无齿吻端。

evidence_anchors.whole: Ryan Somma Smithsonian mounted T.proriger photograph actually viewed; skull, ribcage, limbs and long caudal column visible, oblique mount and terminal tail at image edge. AMNH FR221 supplementary true photo viewed, tail cropped and not a complete silhouette.
evidence_anchors.rostrum: Stewart and Mallon2018 Fig1A CMN8162 real skull with8cm photographic scale; Fig1B10cm drawing separately labeled. p77 text42mm toothless premaxillary rostrum before first premaxillary teeth. Rounded blunt tip, not a tusk or horn. Independent subadult material, used qualitatively.
evidence_anchors.scale: Everhart2006 Paludicola5(4):170–183 p178 explicitly identifies USNM8898 T.proriger approximately9m, citing his2004 study. Scale approximate only; component lengths inferred.
evidence_anchors.taxonomy: AMNH2026 news distinguishes T.rex and reassigns Bunker/Sophie; those specimens and old >12m generalizations excluded. Existing traditional T.proriger evidence retained, no claim full2026 matrix read.

scale.interpretation: Nominal9m axial length. All subdivisions are inference, not specimen measurements. Rostrum about9%head length is a conservative adult modeling target, not copied from juvenile42mm. Adjust within scientifically supported silhouette, preserving conspicuous tooth-free rounded premaxillary tip.

morphology: Long powerful but streamlined trunk, short neck, elongated tapering head; no external gills, crocodile dorsal scutes or dorsal back fin.

Main gate: rounded blunt premaxillary rostral tip extends visibly anterior to tooth row. No teeth in foremost0.10m nominal upper tip. Lower jaw also ends with a short tooth-free symphyseal front, not fangs at the extreme snout. Do not turn this into needle rostrum, tusk or ram horn.

Conical recurved teeth begin behind blunt rostral tip, moderate jaw opening12degrees shows gate. Simplified12visibleteethperjawside is rendering choice, not dental formula. Temporal skull openings covered by flesh.
Four broad fleshed paddles supported by limb skeletons, fore somewhat larger than hind. Distinct shoulder and hip roots; no exposed individual land digits or turtle claws.

Long laterally compressed tail, deeper proximal section and tapered caudal peduncle, with a restrained hypocercal fin: vertebral/lower lobe bends ventrally, upper lobe soft tissue inferred from related mosasaurs, not directly preserved in these Tylosaurus sources. No whale horizontal flukes or giant symmetrical crescent.
Muted dark slate back and pale ventrum artistic inference. Do not copy mounted fossil arched dorsal pose or matrix texture; gentle swimming posture only.

shape_gate.required_combination: Long blunt tooth-free rostral projection preceding toothed long jaws, robust elongated trunk, four paddles and long compressed swimming tail. Whole organism retained.
shape_gate.comparisons: Platecarpus has a proportionally smaller shorter head and no projecting tooth-free rostral knob. Tylosaurus must not pass by scaling/recoloring Platecarpus. Ichthyosaurs have large eyes, needle-like fully toothed jaws and different tail bend; no dolphin-like clone.
acceptance: Lateral front view clearly separates rounded edentulous tip from first tooth and jaw opening.
Top view shows blunt narrow snout widening to skull rear and all four paddles.
Head-on side view verifies head/body depth and no pencil-thin needle tip.
Perspective keeps whole tail/paddles visible and retains rostral gate at useful preview size.

AMNH2026 T.rex mosasaur classification news
Lindgren et al2010 Convergent evolution in aquatic tetrapods: insights from an exceptional fossil mosasaur

description.en: A tall penguin reconstruction with a long spear-shaped bill and broad flattened flippers. The head and bill are comparative restorations, not directly established by an associated skull; soft tissues and colour are inferred.
description.zh: 高大企鹅的完整复原，具有长矛状喙和宽扁鳍肢。头与喙来自比较复原，非关联头骨的直接实证；软组织与颜色为推断。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole tall penguin with long spear-shaped bill and broad flattened flippers, original reconstruction with explicitly inferred head.

scientific_limits.en: MLP12-I-20-289 is a partial postcranial skeleton lacking skull and complete wings. Its femur and coracoid are measured; whole length is allometric estimate, not standing height or articulated measurement. Fig1 is an author schematic not to scale, not a fossil head. No reliably associated Palaeeudyptes skull establishes this bill: long spear bill derives from tentative Palaeeudyptes/Anthropornis cranial assignments and comparative stem penguins. Exact head, flipper outline, colors and soft tissues are original estimates. Do not borrow Icadyptes skull as genus-specific evidence or claim a2m individual.
scientific_limits.zh: MLP12-I-20-289为部分颅后骨架，无颅及完整翼。股骨/乌喙骨为实测，全长为异速推估非站高或关联全体实测。Fig1是作者不按比例示意，头不是化石。无可靠关联本属颅能实证此喙，长矛喙来自暂归本属/Anthropornis的头部及干群企鹅比较；具体头/鳍轮廓、色彩、软组织为原创估计，不拿Icadyptes颅当本属证据，不夸称2米个体。

frozen_scientific_scope.taxon: Palaeeudyptes, body anchored to P. klekowskii
frozen_scientific_scope.classification: Aves, Sphenisciformes; extinct stem penguin, not a modern crown species

scale.model_status: Dimensions labeled model are artistic estimates. Published length range is full body length, not vertical standing height.

diagnostic_targets: Tall upright elongated penguin body, moderately long neck tapering to small head, not a squat modern penguin toy.
Long narrow straight spear-shaped bill, explicitly comparative inference; not hooked parrot bill or broad duck bill.
Broad dorsoventrally flattened paddle flippers with clear shoulder transition and tapering tip, not feathered flying wings or cylinders.
Moderately deep body with short legs set low and rearward, broad supporting webbed feet, short wedge tail.
Restrained neutral inferred plumage, no claimed fossil pigment or modern emperor yellow ear patches.
Keep full bird coherent: bill, neck, body, both flippers and feet; no skeleton/slab downgrade.
