description.en: A swimming eurypterid reconstruction with walking limbs, a paddle pair, twelve trunk segments and a straight telson. Thickness, posture and missing appendage ends are inferred from incomplete same-species fossils.
description.zh: 游泳型板足鲎复原，具有步行附肢、一对桨肢、十二节躯干与直尾剑。体厚、姿态和缺失附肢末端依据不完整同种化石推定。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete small-bodied swimming eurypterid with compact carapace, four walking-appendage pairs, a paddle pair, twelve tapering trunk segments and straight telson. Main anchor MGM1758X, with same-species dorsal comparison MGM5868X.

scientific_limits.en: Interpretive reconstruction, not scan of a single complete carcass. Tetlie/Rabano2007 estimate MGM1758X about200mm if straight; specimen is ventral and bent. Dorsal carapace features supplemented from same-species MGM5868X, not its different150mm size. Depth, posture and missing limb tips inferred. TypeA genital appendage interpreted female, not proven sex. No giant pterygotid claws or modern scorpion sting.
scientific_limits.zh: 解释性复原，非完整尸体扫描。2007论文估MGM1758X若伸直约200毫米，原标本弯曲并为腹面。背甲细节参考同种MGM5868X，不借其150毫米尺寸。厚度姿态与缺损足端为推断，A型生殖附肢解释为雌性但非确定性别。不混巨型翼肢鲎钳或现代蝎毒刺。

scale.uncertainty: 200mm straightened total author estimate, not exact measurement. Subdivisions from Plate1A and same-species historical proportions; dorsal comparison supplies shape only.

anatomy: Compact subtrapezoidal rounded-front carapace, paired kidney-shaped lateral eyes and tiny median ocelli; shallow lateral embayments outside eyes distinguish remipes.

Twelve trunk tergites: six broader anterior segments followed by six narrowing posterior segments. Straight slender telson continues posterior axis, with subtle distal marginal serrations, never arched scorpion sting.
One pair small anterior chelicerae; four pairs walking limbs II-V. First three walking pairs relatively stout with restrained paired spines; fourth longer, slender and less spinose.
Sixth appendage pair forms broad oval distal swimming paddles on articulated stalks. Keep paddles distinct from legs and readable bilaterally. No oversized toothed claws.
Ventral metastoma and simplified operculum; modest TypeA median appendage may follow1758X without invented male structures. Do not expose internal bookgills as external fins.
Matte muted cuticle palette, living hues unknown; omit excessive tiny scales while preserving segmentation and outline.
restoration_boundaries: Plate1A MGM1758X is the actual ventral main specimen, approximately200mm straightened with most prosomal appendages. Photo and1cmbar actually viewed.
Plate1C MGM5868X shows dorsal head and paddle silhouette; original140mm plus missingtelson tip about10mm. Used for shape only, never mixed as200mm same individual.
Plate1B same-species specimens show serratedtelson and head embayment. Plate1D is E.tetragonophthalmus and must NOT be used.
Historic Clarke/Ruedemann1912 remipes description supports limb arrangement and twelve-segment trunk; modern2007 species separation takes precedence over old broad synonyms.
Missing extremities, gentle straightening and three-dimensional body volume interpretive, without claiming exact soft-tissue preservation.

reference_credits.title: Tetlie and Rabano2007, Specimens of Eurypterus in Museo Geominero, Boletin Geologico y Minero118:117–126,Plate1
Clarke and Ruedemann1912, The Eurypterida of New York, Eurypterus remipes description
Tetlie2006, Two new Silurian species of Eurypterus and phylogeny of genus

description.en: A complete sauropod reconstruction with a relatively short neck and paired upper-body ridges. Forked neural spines are supported by bone evidence; their external soft-tissue covering, neck posture and colour are inferred.
description.zh: 完整蜥脚类复原，具有相对短颈和成对上躯脊线。分叉神经棘有骨骼证据，外部软组织包覆、颈姿态与颜色为推断。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete sauropod with relatively short neck and paired/forked upper-body neural-spine ridge; original whole-organism target, not isolated spine or a renamed generic sauropod.

scientific_limits.en: Artistic living reconstruction using Berlin mounted skeleton. Head is a cast; mount includes restored anatomy and is not an untouched single skeleton.13m target is based on historical mount horizontal length reported in Wiedemann et al.1999 Table1, not live body length measured along a curved spine. NHM20m is a separate genus estimate, not applied here. Forked bony neural spines are evidenced, but their external soft-tissue ridge and colour are inferred; no claim exposed bare bones, tall horn sheaths or Amargasaurus-like giant spines. Life neck posture remains uncertain.
scientific_limits.zh: 依据柏林装架进行完整活体美术复原。头骨为铸模，装架含补配，并非原封单个体。13米目标依据Wiedemann等1999表1历史装架水平长度，非沿弯曲脊柱测量的活体长度；NHM20米为另一个属级估值，本模型不套用。分叉骨性神经棘有证据，体表双脊软组织形态与颜色为推断；不宣称裸露骨骼、巨角鞘或阿马加龙式超长棘。活体颈姿态仍有不确定性。

scale.basis: Approximate reconstruction scale based on Berlin mount horizontal13m in Wiedemann et al.1999 Table1, not curved axial/live length.

diagnostic_targets: Relatively short neck: approximately half presacral column in Christian2002, rather than elongate Diplodocus neck.
Paired dorsal relief over posterior neck/shoulder-upper trunk follows bifid neural spines; modest flesh-covered ridges, not Amargasaurus spikes.
Broad deep torso, hindlimbs longer than forelimbs, shoulder lower than hip.
Small elongate blunt snout with restored-head uncertainty; avoid Camarasaurus box skull.
Full long tapering tail substantially longer than neck; four pillar-like limbs.
frozen_scientific_scope.specimen_basis: Actually viewed Berlin photos1999 and2021, plus1999 stereophotogrammetric Fig8/9; cast head explicitly identified in survey. No unsupported catalogue-number association.

reference_credits.title: Wiedemann, Suthau and Albertz1999, Photogrammetric survey of dinosaur skeletons
Christian2002, Neck posture and overall body design in sauropods
Dicraeosaurus hansemanni Berlin mount, Eduard Sola Vazquez1999
Dicraeosaurus Berlin0824, Dosseman2021
Dicraeosaurus, Natural History Museum Dino Directory

description.en: A massive flightless Dromornis planei reconstruction with a deep head and bill and a robust long-legged body. Whole-body proportions, small wings, plumage and colour are comparative restorations, not a complete preserved individual.
description.zh: 大型不飞鸟Dromornis planei的完整复原，具有深厚头喙和粗壮长腿。全身比例、小翼、羽毛与颜色为比较复原，并非完整保存个体。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete massive flightless D. planei with very deep large skull/bill and robust long-legged body. Not D. stirtoni and not a skull-only model.

scientific_limits.en: Species height about2.5m and mass300kg are estimates, not measurements of either illustrated skull. NTM P9464-106 is a braincase, not complete head; NTM P932-2 is a separate rostrum with deformation and surface cavitation. Do not reconstruct its distortion as normal anatomy.2024 study questions extreme narrowness inferred from compressed rostra. Exact whole body proportions, feet, small wings, feathers and colors are comparative soft-tissue restoration. Do not combine D.stirtoni3m/500kg or Australian Museum header illustration with D.planei.
scientific_limits.zh: 约2.5米/300公斤为物种估计，不是两件所示颅标本实测。NTM P9464-106仅颅脑壳；另件NTM P932-2喙有变形空蚀，不复制为正常形态。2024研究质疑压扁标本推得极窄喙。全身比例、足、微小翼、羽毛及颜色属比较复原。不混D.stirtoni三米五百公斤或博物馆页首另一物种插图。

frozen_scientific_scope.classification: Aves, Dromornithidae, Galloanserae; precise galliform/anseriform position debated, recent cranial study favors anseriform affinity.

scale.model_status: All living model dimensions are restoration estimates; scale bars are genuine source graphic calibrations, not measured full-head length.

diagnostic_targets: Very large deep short head and high curved bill, unlike low goose-like Genyornis or long spear penguin bill.
Maintain rounded high dorsal bill profile and strong lower jaw; do not reproduce cavitation, cracks or extreme compressed side width.
Long substantial curved neck entering massive deep body, not an ostrich with tiny head.
Robust long supporting hind limbs and broad forward toes; no webbing, no mammal paws.
Strong flightless silhouette with tiny inferred wings against body and short feathered rear contour.
Full standing bird, no3m D.stirtoni scaling, no fossil slab or skull-only downgrade.

reference_credits.title: Dromornis planei (Bullockornis planei)
Endocranial Anatomy of the Giant Extinct Australian Mihirung Birds (Aves,Dromornithidae)
Skull morphology of the enigmatic Genyornis newtoni
Dromornis planei skull photograph

description.en: A small ceratopsian reconstruction with a short low frill, deep hornless head and complete tapering tail. It combines partial skeletal evidence; the beak covering, body width, tail completion and stance are inferred.
description.zh: 小型角龙类的完整复原，具有短低颈盾、深厚无角头部与渐细尾。综合部分骨骼证据，喙鞘、体宽、尾部补全和站姿为推断。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete small ceratopsian retaining low short frill and deep compact hornless head; full torso, four limbs and tapering tail, not a skull-only study.

scientific_limits.en: Artistic living reconstruction. Actual Canadian Museum of Nature fossil display includes multiple partial skeletons and disarticulated bones, not a single in-life articulated pose. Royal Tyrrell skull is a separate exhibit from Tolman Bridge; do not label it CMN8889 or associate it with the photographed skeletons. Surface restoration/compression and soft-tissue shape are uncertain.3m is NHM genus estimate, not a measurement of any illustrated individual. Tail completion, body breadth, stance, beak sheath and colour are reconstructed.
scientific_limits.zh: 完整活体美术复原。加拿大自然博物馆实物展板包含多个部分骨架和散骨，并非单个活体姿势。Tyrrell头骨是Tolman Bridge的另一个展品，不标成CMN8889，也不宣称与展板骨架同体。表面补配、压扁与软组织形态存在不确定性。3米为NHM属级估值，非任何所示个体实测。尾部补全、躯宽、站姿、喙鞘与颜色为复原。

scale.basis: NHM Dino Directory genus estimate, not measured photographed specimen; do not label as CMN8889 length.

diagnostic_targets: Deep compact hornless skull with strongly downturned beak and deep lower jaw.
Short low rear skull shelf/frill close to head; not large upright Protoceratops shield.
No nasal or brow horn, no elaborate frill spikes.
Compact ribcage with robust hindlimbs and shorter forelimbs; four limbs in neutral supported stance.
Complete relatively long tapering tail, no club, plates or Psittacosaurus bristle claim.
frozen_scientific_scope.specimen_basis: Actually viewed Canadian Museum of Nature fossil exhibit photo by Hectonichus and Royal Tyrrell Tolman Bridge skull photo by Etemenanki3; two separate fossil contexts.

reference_credits.title: Leptoceratops fossil display, Canadian Museum of Nature, Hectonichus2012
Leptoceratops skull, Royal Tyrrell Museum, Etemenanki3 2017
Leptoceratops, Natural History Museum Dino Directory

description.en: A Dolichorhynchops osborni reconstruction with an elongated toothed snout, short neck and four tapering paddles. Skull deformation and mount restoration limit direct interpretation; body thickness, paddle contours and colour are inferred.
description.zh: Dolichorhynchops osborni的完整复原，具有细长有齿吻、短颈与四片渐尖桨肢。头骨变形和装架修复限制直接解读，体厚、鳍肢轮廓与颜色为推断。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole living Dolichorhynchops osborni based on holotype KUVP1300, with a slender elongated toothed snout, short neck, rounded trunk, four strongly tapering hydrofoil paddles and short tail. Not a skeleton or isolated skull.

scientific_limits.en: Historic KUVP1300 mounted skeleton photo is real but its skull is plaster and the spacing between cervical vertebrae exaggerated according to Everhart. Use separate actual KUVP1300 skull photo for cranial form: original skull laterally crushed and repaired, not undistorted3D. Paul publisher table explicitly estimates5.2m for KUVP1300; this is a model-scale choice, not museum measurement, and differs from older10foot description quoted in modern directory. Do not silently reconcile those discrepant estimates or claim5.2m established actual length. Soft tissue margins, thickness, fin planforms and color inferred. No giant former D.bonneri now Martinectes or D.tropicensis now Scalamagnus material mixed in.
scientific_limits.zh: KUVP1300历史全体装架照片真实，但头骨为石膏，Everhart明确颈椎间距被夸大；头部另依据真头骨照片，原头骨侧压并有修复，不作无变形三维标本。Paul出版社原表将KUVP1300估计为5.2米，本次仅作为模型名义尺度，不是馆藏实测；与现代目录所引旧10英尺描述不同，不能默默消除分歧或宣称实长已定。软组织、厚度、鳍肢轮廓和颜色推定，不混入已转属的D.bonneri或D.tropicensis巨型材料。

original_scope.en: Planned animal asset: long narrow snout on a short neck and four strongly tapered flippers.
original_scope.zh: 规划中的动物资产：短颈上的细长吻与四支明显渐尖鳍肢。

evidence_anchors.whole: Williston1903 published photograph of mounted holotype KUVP1300, actually viewed. Four elongated tapering paddles and substantial ribcage. Historic mounted head cast and exaggerated neck gaps excluded as exact proportions.
evidence_anchors.skull: Everhart2009 original KUVP1300 left-side skull photo actually viewed, accession printed in image. Long slender dentigerous rostrum, tall posterior cranial region and numerous small teeth. Crushed skull depth and repaired areas not copied as fine geometry.
evidence_anchors.scale: Paul Princeton publisher original PDF p2 actually viewed: estimated total length5.2m KUVP1300. Explicit approximation with competing older10foot description unresolved, no exact single-individual morphometric claim.
evidence_anchors.classification: O Keefe and Byrd2012 original PDF explicitly treats adult D.osborni holotypeKUVP1300 in comparative shoulder anatomy. Former combination Trinacromerum osborni is same taxon, not separate asset; do not conflate T.bentonianum.

scale.scale_specimen: KUVP1300, Paul estimate, disputed against older shorter account
scale.interpretation: All subdivisions inferred. Neck only slightly longer than head and far shorter fraction than cryptoclidids; do not trace exaggerated mounted cervical gaps. Nominal5.2m not exact actual size; no need to scale skull photographs from unverified bar.

morphology: Long narrow tooth-bearing snout, slender ahead of eyes and broadening toward posterior skull; low anterior rostrum and raised posterior cranial region fleshed without exposed temporal holes. No toothless Tylosaurus knob.
Numerous small pointed teeth along both jaw edges, modest8degree opening; simplified~22teethperjawside is rendering choice not complete dental count. No giant pliosaur tusks or shark teeth.
Short but distinct neck around oneheadlength, thickening gradually toward trunk. Not a tiny head on an elasmosaur long neck; do not copy exaggerated gaps of old mount.
Rounded broad ribcage with four powerful hydrofoil limbs. Fore and hind pairs similar substantial size, roots distinct and smoothly joined, negative spaces visible.

All four paddles strongly taper distally, narrow rounded tips rather than broad rounded lobes. Chord:length about0.33–0.35 is an inferred fleshed target based on tapered skeletons. No exposed fingers, claws or angular flat sheets.
Short smoothly tapering tail with conservative skin outline, no large crescent, whale flukes or mosasaur fin. No dorsal fin.
Muted slate/olive back and pale underside artistic inference. No fossil matrix, display supports or reconstructed skull paint pattern.

shape_gate.required_combination: Elongated slender toothed snout on short neck, broad rounded body framed by four strongly tapered paddles. Full organism.
shape_gate.comparisons: Cryptoclidus has head/neck~1:4 and broad paddles with chord:length~0.42; selected Dolichorhynchops about1:1.18 and narrower distal hydrofoils. Plesiosaurus has tiny head and very long neck. Tylosaurus has toothless blunt tip and very long finned tail. Gate must read at equal normalized body length without relying on color or size.
acceptance: Lateral front shows long narrow snout and genuinely short neck.
Top shows all four tapering hydrofoil outlines and distinct narrow tips around broad trunk.
Head-on side checks volumetric head and broad body, no pencil-flat skull.
Perspective preserves negative spaces between paddles and readable short-necked silhouette.

reference_credits.title: Williston1903 Dolichorhynchops osborni holotype mounted skeleton photograph
Everhart2009 Dolichorhynchops osborni holotype KUVP1300
Paul Princeton Field Guide to Mesozoic Sea Reptiles size table
O Keefe and Byrd2012 Ontogeny of shoulder in Polycotylus and plesiosaur viviparity

description.en: A complete eurypterid reconstruction with large spiny third appendages and paired curved blades beside the telson. It combines same-species fossils; incomplete spines, body thickness, colour and behaviour remain uncertain.
description.zh: 完整板足鲎复原，具有大型带棘第三附肢及尾剑旁的成对弯刃。综合同种化石，缺损长棘、体厚、颜色与行为仍有不确定性。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete same-species composite living reconstruction: compact head, enormous spinose third appendages, smaller second appendages, two walking pairs, paddle pair, segmented tapering trunk and paired curved cercal blades beside telson.

scientific_limits.en: Ohio Geological Survey2021 estimates complete animal represented by partial discovery specimen UC24119A at about750mm. Whole anatomy is a same-species synthesis of many fossils, not a single fully preserved animal. Schmidt etal2022 explicitly identify missing distal coxaIII and unknown complete length/angle of hypertrophied podomere4 spines; their depth and some paired spines are inferred. Our corresponding dimensions are conservative reconstruction choices, not measurements. Color and behavior uncertain.
scientific_limits.zh: Ohio地调2021估局部发现标本UC24119A所代表完整动物约750毫米。全体形态综合同种多件化石，非单体完整保存。2022论文明确第三附肢基节远端缺失、第四节超长棘完整长度及夹角未知，体厚及部分成对棘为推断。本模型对应数值是保守补配而非实测，活体颜色及行为不确定。

scale.uncertainty: Body total is published whole-animal estimate, not preserved linear extent. Subdivisions and limbs scaled from same-species scientific reconstruction Fig2. Long spine endpoints and angles not known; selected130mm and moderate divergence illustrative only.

anatomy: Compact rounded headshield with small paired compound eyes and median ocelli; no modern scorpion pincers.

Appendage I small chelicerae. PairII shorter spinose pedipalps; pairIII greatly enlarged raptorial limbs with multiple opposing spines and conspicuous elongate spine pair. Preserve the open space between limbs and spines.
PairsIV/V are modest walking legs; pairVI broad distal swimming paddles on jointed stalks. Do not miscount II/III as giant chelicerae or add four extra walking pairs.
Segmented broad anterior trunk transitioning into narrow posterior trunk; twelve opisthosomal segments including broad pretelson as interpreted in whole reconstruction.
Posterior terminal complex has a central telson and two curved sickle-shaped cercal blades. These are separate forms, not a modern venom stinger, lobster tailfan or pterygotid flattened paddle.
Low-profile ventral metastoma/plates; modest ornament and implied bristles only where they do not obscure silhouette. Matte muted color, no claim of exact preserved living hues.
restoration_boundaries: OhioGeoFactsFig1 is actual partial UC24119A; displaced carapace impression rotated relative to metasoma is burial geometry, not live anatomy.
OhioFig2 dorsal and ventral are published composite reconstruction modified from Caster/Kjellesvig-Waering1964, not photographs. They supply complete original scope, with restored regions disclosed.
Schmidt2022 longspine full length/angle, coxaIII distalpart and some spine pairings unresolved. Keep inferred complementary geometry but do not claim new anatomical certainty or measured performance.
Do not mix Mixopterus kiaeri limbII anatomy or curved scorpionoid telson, and do not borrow Jaekelopterus2.5m size.
Full-body depth, posture, tiny limb terminals and colors interpretive. Conservative static posture, not claimed kinematic validation.

reference_credits.title: Mark E.Peter2021, Megalograptus ohioensis—Ohios Giant Sea Scorpion, Ohio Geological Survey GeoFacts34
Schmidt etal2022, Spines and baskets in apex predatory sea scorpions uncover unique feeding strategies using3D-kinematics

description.en: An Elasmosaurus platyurus reconstruction with an exceptionally long neck and short broad trunk. The skull completion and four paddles are comparative inferences from related elasmosaurids, not preserved parts of the anchor specimen.
description.zh: Elasmosaurus platyurus的完整复原，具有极长颈与短宽躯干。头骨补全和四鳍肢参照近缘薄板龙类推定，并非主锚标本的实存部分。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole living Elasmosaurus platyurus anchored to ANSP10081, retaining extremely elongated neck and short broad trunk. Four paddles and skull completion explicitly inferred from related elasmosaurids; never reduce whole animal to skull or claim a complete fossil exists.

scientific_limits.en: ANSP10081 preserves jaw fragments, almost complete cervical series, incomplete trunk/tail and rib fragments; girdles were documented historically but are now lost; limbs not preserved.72cervicals follows Sachs et al2013 revised count, not an uncritical2005table count. Real fragment photographs and measurements are evidence, not a whole skeleton photograph.10.5m total and7.0m neck are nominal reconstructed scale choices, not direct complete-specimen measurements. Neck scale constrained by centimetre centrum measurements and approximately7m historical estimate reviewed in2013; joint spacing is uncertain. Missing posterior skull, torso width and four paddles use comparative Thalassomedon anatomy, not claimed Elasmosaurus fossil surfaces. Its restored1940mount and modern replica are explicitly distinguished. Soft tissue/color inferred.
scientific_limits.zh: ANSP10081保存颌骨碎片、近完整颈椎序列、不完整躯干尾椎和肋骨；带骨历史有记录但已遗失，四肢未保存。72颈椎依2013修订，不照抄2005表中的旧计数。实物照片与量表非完整骨架照。总长10.5米及颈7米为名义复原尺度而非完整标本实测，颈部依据厘米级椎体量表及2013回顾的约7米旧估计约束，椎间距未知。后颅、躯干宽度和四肢比较补配自同科Thalassomedon，不冒充本属实物；其1940修复展架和现代翻模明确区分。软组织、配色推定。

original_scope.en: Planned animal asset: extremely elongated neck attached to a short broad trunk.
original_scope.zh: 规划中的动物资产：连接短宽躯干的极长颈部。

evidence_anchors.neck: Sachs2005Table2 centimetre measurements ANSP10081, with preserved anterior centra~3.7–6cm and middle~10–12cm; actually viewed. Sachs,Kear,Everhart2013 revised72cervicals and real3cm-scale neck vertebrae Fig1/2 viewed. Primary gate is directly supported by target, not borrowed from comparator.
evidence_anchors.head: Sachs2005Fig1 real premaxillae/dentaries photographed dorsal/ventral,5cm scale viewed. Broadening posteriorly with six premaxillary teeth per side described; complete rear skull not preserved and must be inferred conservatively.
evidence_anchors.body_limbs: Sachs et al2021Fig1 Thalassomedon haningtoni DMNS1588 restored original mountA and replicaB plus UNSM50132C actually viewed. Same-family comparative ribcage/paddle basis only, not this species or exact proportional template. Do not copy whole Thalassomedon neck ratio.
evidence_anchors.scale: Original target vertebral measurements provide real size anchor. Nominal neck7.0m aligns historical7m estimate reviewed by2013 paper; nominal total10.5m=sum inferred0.45head+7neck+2.05trunk+1tail. No claim total10.5m is published measurement.

scale.scale_specimen: ANSP10081 vertebral centimetre measurements; incomplete specimen
scale.interpretation: Nominal axial scale, all flesh boundaries/component subdivision inferred, no direct total length measurement. Neck dominates~67%total and exceeds trunk by~3.4times. Preserve broad substantial body without inflating absent evidence.

morphology: Tiny narrow anterior head widening toward rear, modest mouth opening8degrees with slender recurved teeth. No enormous pliosaur skull. Six premaxillary tooth positions per side supported by actual fragments; complete visible tooth count simplified, not complete fossil formula.

Exceptionally long tapering neck dominates silhouette, roughly two-thirds total length, far longer than broad trunk. Smooth continuous flesh, no exposed vertebral beads. Near-horizontal gentle curve, not swan S or raised periscope.
Neck gently thickens toward shoulder, with body transitioning into a short broad deep rounded ribcage. Fleshed cross-sections inferred and must not make entire animal a thin noodle.
Four substantial tapered hydrofoil paddles surround trunk, comparable front/hind sizes, narrow rounded distal ends. Same-family inference explicitly; no land fingers/claws or giant flat wings.
Short tapering tail follows pelvis with conservative skin silhouette. No enormous tail copied from Cope wrong-end reconstruction, no fish crescent or dorsal fin.
Muted slate/olive back and paler underside inferred. Complete organism, no fossil slab or display rods.

shape_gate.required_combination: Extremely elongated neck with tiny head attached to a short broad trunk framed by four paddles. Original full body unchanged.
shape_gate.comparisons: Plesiosaurus prepared comparator neck~46%total, Cryptoclidus~36% and Dolichorhynchops~19%. Here neck~67% and short broad torso must read at equal length, not merely global enlargement. Thalassomedon is missing-part comparator only; do not copy its entire silhouette.
acceptance: Front lateral shows neck over3timestrunk and tiny head, never a scaled Plesiosaurus clone.
Top shows neck taper plus short broad oval torso and distinct four paddles.
Side head-on checks substantive neck base and body volume, not a flattened ribbon.
Perspective frames whole neck and all limbs; original extreme-neck gate must remain readable at512preview.

reference_credits.title: Sachs2005 Redescription of Elasmosaurus platyurus
Sachs,Kear,Everhart2013 Revised vertebral count in Elasmosaurus platyurus
Sachs et al2021 Cranial osteology of Thalassomedon haningtoni

description.en: An adult Stegoceras reconstruction with a rounded, relatively low dome and a distinct rear skull shelf. Missing skeletal regions, soft tissues, colour and neutral stance are reconstructed; head-butting behaviour is not asserted.
description.zh: 成年Stegoceras的完整复原，具有相对较低的圆顶和明显后颅平台。缺失骨骼、软组织、颜色与中性站姿为复原，不将头撞行为视为定论。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete adult small pachycephalosaur, retaining rounded relatively low dome and distinct flatter rear skull shelf; full trunk, two arms, two hindlimbs and long tail. Not a skull-only object.

scientific_limits.en: Living reconstruction based on UALVP2 original skull photograph and published skeletal reconstruction. Postcranial remains are exceptional but partial; the complete diagram includes reconstructed portions and is not a photograph of a wholly preserved articulated skeleton. 2m is WitmerLab adult estimate, not soft-tissue measurement. Lower dome is comparative, not juvenile flat skull. Soft tissue, colour and neutral pose inferred. Do not assert head-butting behaviour or hypothetical respiratory turbinates as established external anatomy.
scientific_limits.zh: 活体复原依据UALVP2真头骨照片与公开骨架复原图。躯干骨保存难得但仍不完整，完整示意图包含补全，不是全体原位骨架照片。2米是WitmerLab成年估值而非软组织实测。较低圆顶是比较性特征，不做成幼体平头。软组织、颜色与中性站姿为推断；不把头撞行为或假设呼吸鼻甲作为确定外形。

scale.basis: Ohio University WitmerLab UALVP2 adult factsheet: 2m estimate, skull212mm. Not NHM separate2.4m genus estimate.

diagnostic_targets: Rounded adult dome above eyes, modest relative height rather than giant Pachycephalosaurus bulb.
Clear lower flatter posterior skull shelf extending behind dome; small marginal bumps, not long spikes.
Compact beaked head, short neck, broad trunk and pelvis.
Short forelimbs with palms inward, stout hindlimbs in neutral bipedal stance.
Long tapering relatively stiff balancing tail; no club or plates.
frozen_scientific_scope.specimen_basis: Actually viewed Ohio WitmerLab facts/images PDF page9: original skull photo P.Currie UniversityAlberta, UALVP2; skeletal restoration C.Brown RoyalTyrrell. PLOS2022 UALVP2 appendicular myology supports broad torso/pelvis and stout hindlimbs.

reference_credits.title: Facts, images and animations for dinosaur breathing story, Ohio University WitmerLab2014
Moore et al2022, The appendicular myology of Stegoceras validum

description.en: A low-bodied Moeritherium reconstruction with an elongated barrel torso, short legs and a modest muzzle. It combines different individuals; body dimensions and soft tissues are estimates, and no long elephant-like trunk is assumed.
description.zh: Moeritherium的完整复原，具有低矮修长桶状躯干、短腿与适度延长的吻。综合不同个体，身体尺度和软组织为估计，不假定长象鼻。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete living low extremely elongated barrel body with short limbs and modest long muzzle; original618 gate supported by specific2016 research.

scientific_limits.en: Larramendi2016 reconstruction combines young skull C.7867 enlarged15% with postcranial bones of different adults.2.30m length,.70m shoulder height and235kg are composite restoration estimates, not measurements of one articulated individual. Humerus240mm/femur270mm are listed source bone lengths. Body width, skin, ears, lips, feet and color remain inferred. Paris display skull photograph is a cast/reconstruction without measured scale or confirmed specimen number. Cranial/neck/mandibular proportions argue against a conventional trunk; do not add one.
scientific_limits.zh: 2016复原将幼颅C.7867放大15%并结合不同成年个体颅后骨，2.30米长/.70米肩高/235公斤为合成复原估计，非单一个体全身实测。肱240毫米/股270毫米为文献列骨长。宽度、皮肤、耳唇足及颜色为推断。巴黎展颅照片为铸件/复原，无实测尺及确认标本号。颅颈下颌比例不支持常规象鼻，不添加长鼻。

frozen_scientific_scope.classification: Mammalia, Proboscidea, Moeritheriidae; early branch, not a modern elephant or hippo.

scale.scale_status: Living proportions estimates from composite; bone lengths are source values not necessarily same individual.

diagnostic_targets: Very long low barrel trunk and short flexed legs, length-to-shoulder-height about3.3; not a compact baby elephant.
Low elongated skull and modest fleshy muzzle continuous with face, no long hanging trunk.
Small upper incisor tusks with short modest lower incisors, not huge mammoth tusks or hippo canine display.
Short substantial supporting limbs under long trunk, rounded broad feet, no hoof cylinder or horse leg.
Small ears and modest tail, subdued inferred nearly hairless skin, no elephant sail ears or furry mammoth body.
Full animal required; original shape combines low barrel/shortlimbs/modest snout, not merely rescaled other candidate.

reference_credits.title: Shoulder height, body mass, and shape of proboscideans
Moeritherium lyonsi skull display, Paris

description.en: A conservative eurypterid reconstruction with a broad domed headshield, short anterior feeding limbs and a heavy tapering trunk. Missing limb segments and body thickness are estimated from several same-species specimens.
description.zh: 保守的板足鲎活体复原，具有宽拱头盾、短前部摄食附肢和厚重渐细躯干。缺失足节与体厚依据多件同种标本估计。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete conservative living reconstruction of broad domed headshield, short anterior sweep-feeding limbs, stout unequal walking limbs and heavy tapering segmented trunk with keeled telson; same-species composite, not a single complete fossil replica.

scientific_limits.en: Main anatomical anchor BMNH In.62181 is distorted, with posterior body curled under the head and distal posterior legs missing. Approximate115mm head width estimated from printed Fig1 magnification is not a published direct measurement. Restored300mm total length, body depth and limb completion are illustrative estimates. Tail supplemented by same-species NMS G1992.14.6; appendageIV terminal morphology by GLAHM A23078. Whyte2005 Fig1c supplies only general hibbertopteroid posture, not species identity or its giant trackmaker scale. No dense filtering hairs are claimed.
scientific_limits.zh: 主锚BMNH In.62181受压变形，后体卷于头下且后足远端缺失。头宽约115毫米来自图1印刷倍率估计，并非论文直接实测。补全体长300毫米、体厚及缺失足节为解释性估值；尾部借同种NMS G1992.14.6，第四附肢末端参考GLAHM A23078。Whyte2005图1c仅辅助该类群整体姿态，不借其巨型足迹尺寸或确定种身份。不宣称保存了密集滤食毛。

scale.uncertainty: Fig1 x0.5 printed magnification and image proportions give head width approximately110-120mm; distorted outline. Total300mm is our conservative completion, not specimen measurement. Do not use650mm giant carapace or1.6m trackmaker total.

anatomy: Wide rounded domed headshield with posterolateral lobes; paired small lateral eyes plus median ocelli, modest lunulate ornament, no giant modern horseshoe crab eye stalks.
AppendageI small chelicerae under mouth. II andIII short robust gathering limbs with flat sensory flanges/spines; not long lobster claws or dense Cyrtoctenus filtering combs.

PairIV intermediate limb with sensory tibial spine but non-sensory distal podomeres, small articulated tarsal spur and terminal tarsus. IV also contributes support. V andVI stout walking limbs of unequal length, VI longest. Five postcheliceral pairs total, no added paddle pair.

At least three locomotory pairs IV-VI are consistent with trackway reconstruction. Two posterior pairs preserved in BMNH underpin scale; complete distal V/VI conservative inference, not direct preserved anatomy.

Broad heavy anterior opisthosoma narrowing through posterior segments, approximately12 segments according to conventional eurypterid reconstruction; dorsal lateral pleurae modest, not trilobite spines.
Terminal pointed telson with ventral keel, raised shoulders and median groove. Tail tapers behind body, no swimming paddle, poison sting, paired sickle cercal blades or lobster fan.
Low ventral plates/metastoma visible where appropriate. Muted matte brown live colors illustrative, not inferred from rock.
restoration_boundaries: BMNH In.62181 actual specimen Fig2b/c and interpreted Fig1 are main anchor, not lectotypeG55/76. Restore distortion and do not model tucked-under burial geometry as normal posture.
Same-species tail NMS G1992.14.6 Fig3f is a separate specimen. Use form, not its independent size as main-body measurement.
GLAHM A23078 Fig4A supports probable fourth appendage terminal. Fig4B belongs cfDunsopterus and must not be borrowed.
Fig2a belongs Cyrtoctenus and must not be used as Hibbertopterus dense filtering comb.1994 etched sensory rings did not show hairs, despite older interpretation.

Whyte2005 Fig1c is a whole hibbertopteroid trackmaker reconstruction with left limbs omitted for clarity. Restore bilateral symmetry, not three legs total; do not claim that trackmaker is selected specimen.
Missing distal legs, absolute total length, depth, posture and color are conservative reconstruction choices. No old swimmer reconstruction.

reference_credits.title: Jeram and Selden1994, Eurypterids from the Visean of East Kirkton, West Lothian, Scotland
Whyte2005, A gigantic fossil arthropod trackway, Nature438:576

description.en: A Mosasaurus missouriensis reconstruction with a robust head, elongated trunk, four paddles and a compressed swimming tail. Tail-fin skin, soft tissues and colour are inferred from comparative evidence, not a complete single specimen.
description.zh: Mosasaurus missouriensis的完整复原，具有粗壮头部、长躯、四桨肢与侧扁游泳尾。尾鳍皮肤、软组织和颜色依据比较证据推定，并非单个完整标本。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole living Mosasaurus missouriensis: robust monitorlike head, elongated trunk, four paddles and laterally compressed swimming tail. Genus-level original ID retained; not a skull-only asset and not giant M.hoffmannii extrapolation.

scientific_limits.en: Main scale/head anchorTMP2012.010.0001 is about6.5m with90cm skull in Konishi et al2026 conference abstract p49, not a full osteological monograph. Actual skull photograph viewed; full skeleton photo of this individual not obtained. Separate same-species TMP2008.036.0001 partial skull/trunk/limb fossil photograph supports body construction qualitatively, not adult proportions or a complete tail. Do not claim all photos same specimen or a single-specimen digital twin. Tail-fin skin and bilateral restoration inferred from related mosasaur anatomy, with preserved original head gate retained. Skeleton flattening, injury, jaw displacement and matrix not live shape. Soft tissue, volume, color and component lengths inferred.
scientific_limits.zh: 主要尺度和头骨锚TMP2012.010.0001在Konishi等2026会议摘要第49页为全长约6.5米、头90厘米，非完整骨学专著。已查看真头骨照片，未取得该个体全骨架图。另一同种TMP2008.036.0001局部头躯干肢骨照片仅定性补身体，不冒成体比例或完整尾证据；不称所有照片为同标本或数字孪生。尾鳍皮肤和双侧复原参考近缘沧龙类推定，原粗壮头形态保持。压扁、伤口、脱位及基质不照搬成活体。软组织、体积、颜色、细分尺寸推定。

original_scope.en: Planned animal asset: robust monitorlike head on an elongated flipper-bearing trunk.
original_scope.zh: 规划中的动物资产：伸长鳍肢躯干上的粗壮巨蜥状头。

evidence_anchors.head: Bloopityboop2020 original TMP2012.010.0001 skull photo actually viewed, Commons metadata names specimen and original not cast. Long toothed rostrum, substantial posterior skull/jaws; bone injury not genus character. Museum2020factsheet independently identifies KoriteM.missouriensis with embedded tooth.
evidence_anchors.body: FalkenXIX photograph TMP2008.036.0001 actually viewed: authentic partial articulated skull, neck/ribcage and limb elements,10cm photo scale. Tail not preserved in this image; not called complete body. Comparative same-species support only, two individuals kept distinct.
evidence_anchors.scale: Konishi,Scott,Brown,Brink,Brinkman2026 CSVPabstract p49 explicitly calls TMP2012.010.0001 virtually complete adult M.missouriensis,~6.5m and90cm skull. Original abstract-volumePDF stored and relevantpageviewed.
evidence_anchors.tail: Lindgren et al2010 Platecarpus natural tail bend and regionalization, already acquired originalPDF copied self-contained. Related-taxon inference, no direct M.missouriensis soft-tissue fin claimed.

scale.interpretation: Total/head anchored to approximate author values; every other division and soft tissue width inferred. Do not import a17m M.hoffmannii estimate or juvenile specimen scale.

morphology: Robust elongated monitorlike head with substantial rear jaw muscle region, widening behind long tapering snout; head about14%total. Fleshed rear skull deep and broad enough to read as powerful reptile, not tiny-headed Platecarpus or needle-snouted ichthyosaur.

Pointed recurved conical marginal teeth begin near rostral tip; no long tooth-free Tylosaurus knob. Modest12degree gape. Simplified~14visibleteethperjawside is rendering convention, not a precise tooth formula. No unnaturally swollen giant shark gape.
Short neck smoothly joins elongated muscular ribcage, substantial but streamlined body. No exposed temporal holes or skeletal windows.
Four fleshed paddle limbs with distinct roots and tapered rounded distal margins, fore somewhat larger. No separated terrestrial fingers or turtle claws; no flat triangular sheets.

Long laterally compressed tail with proximal deepening, narrow peduncle and restrained hypocercal fin. Vertebral/lower lobe bends ventrally; upper soft-tissue lobe is explicit related-mosasaur inference. No horizontal whale fluke or back dorsal fin.
No crocodile scutes, fossil matrix or individual bite pathology baked into generic silhouette. Muted gray/olive back and pale belly artistic inference.

shape_gate.required_combination: Robust long toothed monitorlike head with strong posterior jaw region on elongated four-paddle swimming trunk. Full organism.
shape_gate.comparisons: Tylosaurus comparator has conspicuous toothless blunt rostral knob; here teeth reach near tip and deeper wider posterior head. Platecarpus has proportionally smaller short head; do not merely enlarge/recolor its whole silhouette. Ichthyosaurus has needlelike rostrum, dominant eye and different caudal axis.
acceptance: Front lateral shows deep posterior head and toothed rostrum without tooth-free knob.
Top shows clear cranial widening behind tapered snout, substantial elongated torso and four paddles.
Head-on side confirms volumetric jaw muscle region, not a thin skull plate.
Perspective preserves original robust-head/elongated-body gate and whole-tail extent at512preview.

description.en: A terrestrial predator reconstruction with a large elongated head, shearing cheek teeth and a long balancing tail. Body size, soft tissues, ears, coat and colour are reconstruction estimates, not measurements of one complete skeleton.
description.zh: 陆生捕食者的完整复原，具有大型狭长头部、剪切型颊齿与长平衡尾。体型、软组织、耳、毛被和颜色为复原估计，并非单个完整骨架的实测。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole terrestrial predator with proportionately large elongated head, readable shearing cheek teeth and long balancing tail.

scientific_limits.en: 2022 Fig1B is a skeletal reconstruction reproduced from Scott and Jepsen, normalized by thorax length, not an absolute scale or one confirmed complete specimen.2011 Fig8 caption gives25cm skull length but no explicit catalog identification in caption; do not equate it with SDSM3017 or493. Named tooth measurements are distinct source specimens. Full body dimensions, skin, ears, tail soft tissues and color are restoration estimates. Never scale giant Asian species or modern hyena body proportions into H.horridus.
scientific_limits.zh: 2022 Fig1B是据Scott与Jepsen的复原骨架，按胸部长度归一化，非绝对尺或已确认完整单标本。2011 Fig8标25厘米颅长但图注未具名号，不能擅定为SDSM3017/493。具名齿测量是独立标本。身体尺寸及耳皮毛尾色为复原估计，不混亚洲巨型种或现代鬣狗比例。

frozen_scientific_scope.classification: Mammalia, Hyaenodonta, Hyaenodontidae; not Hyaenidae or modern Carnivora. Creodonta is historical grouping.

scale.model_status: Absolute living dimensions chosen estimates anchored loosely to published25cm skull; named canine measurements not claims same individual.

diagnostic_targets: Large long skull relative to torso, deep jaw behind long muzzle; not modern hyena short head or oversized sabrecat canine display.
Show enlarged blade-like shearing cheek teeth behind canines in modestly open mouth; teeth gate cannot vanish behind closed lips.
Long tapered muscular tail clearly distinct from short hyena tail.
Moderately elongated low torso and substantial semi-digitigrade limbs with differentiated wrist/hock, no tall slender wolf silhouette.
Small restrained ears and neutral inferred fur; no striped/spotted modern hyena coat or dramatic mane.
Complete original animal, not skull-only, preserve longhead/shearingteeth/longtail combination.

UMMP VP3731 Hyaenodon horridus

description.en: A low, broad titanosaur reconstruction with small dermal armour elements and a long neck and tail. Fossils support armour presence, but its full-body arrangement, soft tissues and colour remain reconstructed.
description.zh: 低而宽厚的泰坦巨龙类复原，具有小型皮内骨甲及长颈长尾。化石支持骨甲存在，但全身排列、软组织与颜色仍为复原。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete low broad titanosaur with small embedded dermal armour elements, long neck, four limbs and tapering tail. Not an isolated osteoderm or fossil fragment.

scientific_limits.en: Original living reconstruction. Hartman2022 dorsal/lateral skeletal drawing is a reconstruction, not a photograph of a complete individual; 8.8m is its estimated reconstructed length. Original dermal plates and ossicle clusters support armour presence and local structure, not exact whole-body placement or rows. Body breadth, neck posture, missing bones, soft tissues and colour remain reconstructed. Do not equate all PVL4017 bones with one individual.
scientific_limits.zh: 原创活体复原。Hartman2022背/侧骨架图是复原而非完整个体照片，8.8米为该复原估计长度。真实骨甲与小骨片簇支持骨甲存在及局部结构，不确定全身位置和排列。躯宽、颈姿、缺失骨骼、软组织及颜色均含复原；不把所有PVL4017骨骼视为同一个体。

scale.basis: Scott Hartman2022 named dorsal/lateral reconstruction estimated8.8m; not a measured complete fossil. NHM12m is a separate genus estimate not used.

diagnostic_targets: Low broad barrel-shaped trunk and wide pelvis, not tall narrow Brachiosaurus shoulders.
Relatively modest neck with small head, long tapering tail and four stout limbs.
Small embedded rounded/subconical dermal plates as restrained shallow bumps, not large pointed armour or flat Stegosaurus plates.
Tiny7–10mm ossicles have inferred flat polygonal outer faces; simplify as subtle local surface detail, not hundreds of giant rounded nodules.
Whole-body placement of armour explicitly reconstructed; no claimed precise fossil row pattern.
frozen_scientific_scope.specimen_basis: Actually viewed Cerda/Powell2010 Fig1 PVL4017-113 dermal plate and Fig3 PVL4017-208/-119 ossicle clusters. Hartman2022 named dorsal/lateral whole skeleton restoration supplies broad body proportions, not actual specimen completeness.

reference_credits.title: Cerda and Powell2010, Dermal armor histology of Saltasaurus loricatus
Scott Hartman2022, Saltasaurus loricatus dorsal and left lateral skeletal reconstruction

description.en: A complete Aeger shrimp reconstruction with a curved segmented body, long rostrum, spiny third maxillipeds and a tail fan. Body width, hidden limbs and missing extremities are inferred from a laterally compressed fossil.
description.zh: Aeger虾的完整复原，具有弯曲分节躯干、长额剑、带棘第三颚足与尾扇。体宽、被遮挡附肢和缺失末端依据侧压化石推定。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete Late Jurassic Aeger shrimp reconstructed around MNHN.F.B13441: slender curved segmented body, long narrow rostrum, exceptionally long spinose third maxillipeds, five walking leg pairs and tail fan.

scientific_limits.en: MNHN.F.B13441 is a laterally compressed fossil, not an intact three-dimensional animal. Body length about100mm excluding rostrum/antennae is estimated along the curved body from Fig1A20mm bar; rostrum about30mm and third maxilliped reach about65mm are approximate figure-derived proportions, not published measurements. Body width, bilateral hidden appendages and terminal details are conservative reconstructions. Generic Aeger appendage evidence is supplementary and not direct preservation of every part on this specimen. Living color unknown.
scientific_limits.zh: MNHN.F.B13441是侧压化石，不是完整三维动物。体长约100毫米不含额剑触角，沿图1A弯曲躯干以20毫米尺估计；额剑约30毫米、第三颚足伸展约65毫米均为图比例估计，非论文实测。体宽、隐藏的对侧附肢及末端细节保守补配。属级附肢证据仅作补充，不声称主标本每一处均保存。活体颜色未知。

scale.uncertainty: Approximate same-figure ratios with20mmbar, tolerance about20percent; do not borrow9.5cmPRI50595 or26cmAntrimposR03502.

anatomy: Elongate smooth lateral carapace, modest stalked eyes, long narrow rostrum characteristic of A.spinipes, unlike short hook-like A.tipularius. Include conservative single subrostral spine, no modern sawtooth row.
Two long antennae plus paired branched antennules; endpoints conservative where incomplete. Antennae thin but renderable, not solid horns.

Distinct paired third maxillipeds extend conspicuously anteroventrally, with a readable row of slender projecting spines. These are mouth appendages, not the first walking-leg pair or lobster giant claws.

Five pereiopod pairs behind maxillipeds. P1-P3 small chelate tips; P4-P5 slender simple tips. Generic Aeger evidence supports spines on anterior walking limbs, but simplify fine uncertain arrangements and retain gaps.
Six abdominal somites in a moderate shrimp-like curve, tapering posteriorly; paired small pleopods beneath abdomen are conservative group-informed reconstruction.
Terminal telson between paired uropods produces a spread tail fan. Not a scorpion sting or a broad crab abdomen.
Low-poly subdued ochre/brown colors are artistic. Do not use stone texture or fossil flattening as live anatomy.
restoration_boundaries: Primary2012Fig1A is MNHN.F.B13441 A.spinipes Eichstatt, same identity retained in museum2019citation. Fig1B poorly identified tipularius andFig1C Acanthochira are not primary anatomy orscale.
Long spinose third maxilliped gate supported by actual main photo and Aeger generic diagnosis; detailed bilateral complement inferred, not a second unreported specimen.
2017A.brevirostris detailed anatomy only provides genus-level conservative appendage count and structure; do not borrow its55mmcarapace size or species-specific grooves.
No copied reference meshes, no modern shrimp substitution. Preserve original complete organism, not fossil slab.

reference_credits.title: Charbonnier and Garassino2012, The marine arthropods from the Solnhofen Lithographic Limestones
MNHN.F.B13441, Aeger spinipes, Eichstatt Late Jurassic
Etter2004, Decapod crustaceans from the Middle Jurassic Opalinus Clay
Jauvion etal2017, A new look at the shrimps

description.en: A whole-animal reconstruction with large upper tusks, smaller lower tusks and an elongated low torso. The short fleshy nose, lips, foot pads, ears, tail and colour are inferred; a long elephant-like trunk is not assumed.
description.zh: 完整活体复原，具有大型上獠牙、较小下獠牙和低而修长的躯干。短肉质鼻、唇、足垫、耳尾与颜色为推断，不假定长象鼻。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole animal with large downward upper tusks and shorter lower tusks, retracted nasal region with inferred short fleshy nose, substantial elongated low torso.

scientific_limits.en: Field Museum skeleton14251 is mounted lying down, not proof that living legs were extremely short.1990 paper reports1.37m shoulder and2.88m nose-to-pelvis for this specimen, not a species mean and not tail-inclusive total length.1935 popular account rounds to nearly5ft and9.5ft. Soft trunk/lip, pads, ears, tail outline and color inferred; no long elephant trunk. Actual forelimbs relatively strong and hindquarters lighter. Fossil skeleton includes reconstruction, not an untouched articulated carcass.
scientific_limits.zh: Field14251展架为卧姿，不能据此造极短腿。1990文献该件肩高1.37米/鼻尖到骨盆2.88米，非物种均值也不含尾全长；1935通俗文约五英尺/九点五英尺是约数。鼻唇、足垫、耳尾色为推断，无长象鼻；前肢强后躯较轻。展骨包含复原并非完整原状尸体。

frozen_scientific_scope.classification: Mammalia, Astrapotheria, Astrapotheriidae; South American native ungulate, not elephant or tapir.

scale.status: Specimen dimensions quoted by Marshall etal1990; soft tissue and individual tusk lengths chosen estimates, not directly measured.

diagnostic_targets: Large long head with two upper canine tusks curving downward and a shorter paired lower set, no elephant-incisor arrangement.
High retracted nasal opening represented through short fleshy mobile nose/lip, clearly labeled inferred, no long dangling elephant trunk.
Substantial elongated low torso with deep chest, rather than spherical hippo or tall elephant body.
Strong forelimbs and lighter hindquarters; retain real joint heights rather than copying lying museum mount.
Broad padded support feet; five foredigits described in source but soft pads inferred, no huge separated claws.
Neutral inferred skin, moderate ears/tail; complete original animal not skull-only.

Astrapotherium sp.(Mammalia,Astrapotheriidae) from Miocene strata along the Quepuca River,central Chile

description.en: A complete high-backed sauropod reconstruction with an elevated mid-dorsal profile. The skeleton is very incomplete: much of the head, neck, limbs and tail is inferred, and the exact external soft-tissue ridge is unknown.
description.zh: 完整高背蜥脚类复原，呈现明显抬高的背中部轮廓。骨架很不完整，头颈、四肢和尾的许多部分为推定，体表软组织脊的确切形态未知。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete high-backed sauropod with distinctly elevated mid-dorsal profile, full neck/head, four limbs and long tail. Original whole-organism target, not isolated vertebra.

scientific_limits.en: Highly incomplete skeleton: genuine tall dorsal neural spines and scapula inform trunk, but head, much of neck, limbs and tail require reconstruction. Whole silhouette is artistic, not evidence of a complete preserved individual.20m is NHM genus estimate, not measured fossil length. Tall bony support is established, but external sail or fleshy ridge structure and function are not preserved. Neutral modest tissue-covered high back chosen without claiming exact soft tissue.
scientific_limits.zh: 骨架很不完整：真实高背椎神经棘与肩胛支持躯干，头、颈及肢尾多处需推定。完整外轮廓是美术复原，不是保存完整个体的证据。20米为NHM属级估值，非化石实测。高骨性支撑有证据，外部帆或肉质脊形态和功能并未保存，采用中性覆肉高背而不宣称确切软组织。

scale.basis: NHM Dino Directory genus estimate. Not measured holotype full length.

diagnostic_targets: Clearly tall mid-back profile rising above shoulder and pelvis, supported by exceptionally elongated dorsal neural spines.
High profile integrated with trunk as tissue-covered ridge, not separate giant exposed bone needles.
Relatively modest neck and small reconstructed head, robust quadruped and long tapering tail.
No duplicated Amargasaurus neck spike rows, no Stegosaurus plates, no invented tail club.
Head shape conservatively reconstructed; specialized Nigersaurus broad muzzle is not demonstrated for this taxon.
frozen_scientific_scope.specimen_basis: Actually viewed Ibrahimetal2020 Fig104 holotype dorsal vertebra in two views and scapula; Wilson/Allain2015 describes partial holotype. Additional known-material silhouette only illustrates extensive missing regions, not primary anatomical evidence.

reference_credits.title: Ibrahim etal2020, Geology and paleontology of the Upper Cretaceous Kem Kem Group, Fig104
Wilson and Allain2015 Osteology of Rebbachisaurus garasbae
Rebbachisaurus, Natural History Museum Dino Directory
Slate Weasel2021 Rebbachisaurus known-material diagram

description.en: A small enrolled Agnostus reconstruction with two free thoracic segments and nine appendage pairs. It represents the first holaspid stage; missing shield edges and limbs are conservatively restored, fine setae simplified and colour unknown.
description.zh: 小型卷曲Agnostus复原，具有两枚游离胸节和九对附肢，表现首个holaspid阶段。缺失盾缘与附肢保守补配，细刚毛简化，活体颜色未知。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete first holaspid living reconstruction with matching rounded cephalic and pygidial shields, exactly two liberated thoracic tergites and nine appendage pairs; moderately gaping enrolled posture rather than a featureless closed shell.

scientific_limits.en: UB822 is the actual first-holaspid anatomical anchor, with published cephalic shield840x820micrometers and partial ventral preservation. Missing border and appendages are reconstructed from same-species h1 reconstruction and adjacent late-meraspid anatomy, not claimed preserved on UB822. Two free thoracic tergites are genuine h1 morphology, not one-segment meraspis. Body total if unfolded about1.8mm is an estimate; modeled gaping span differs. Appendage microsetae simplified, coloration unknown.
scientific_limits.zh: 实际主锚UB822为首个holaspid，论文头盾840×820微米，腹面仅部分保存。缺失盾缘及附肢按同种h1复原和相邻晚meraspid阶段保守补配，不称UB822全部保存。两枚游离胸节是h1真实形态，不以一胸节幼体替代。若展开全长约1.8毫米仅估计，张口卷曲姿态包围尺寸不同。细微刚毛简化，活体颜色未知。

scale.uncertainty: Published UB822shield measurements anchor micro-scale. Totalestimate is not directspecimenlength; use camera fitting, never multiply geometry scale tolooklarger.

anatomy: Broad near-round cephalic shield with smooth fields, modest axial glabellar lobation and narrow rim; no large dorsal compound eyes. Tiny uncertain ventral frontal organs must not become eyes on stalks.

Pygidium almost matching headshape andsize, axial raised area and short paired marginal spines. Two separate narrow articulating thoracic tergites link shields; count only free tergites, not pygidial fused subdivisions.

Moderately gaping enrolled posture based on Fig16B-C, about60degrees opening allows limbs and hinge to remain visible. Not a bivalve with lateralhinge and not flattened fully outstretched contrary to enrollment anatomy.

Four cephalic appendage pairs total: I sigmoidal antennules, II strong multisegmented setose exopod with absent/reduced endopod, III biramous with segmented endopod andstrong exopod, IV smaller biramous leg with club-like endopodalpart.
Five trunk appendage pairs decrease posteriorly, with lastone developed smallleg inh1 rather than meraspidbud. Anterior trunklegs biramous; keep compactundershields, no enormous spiderlegs.
Setae represented by limited broadreadable filaments rather than individual microscopic hairs. Anatomical left-right pairs, no moderncrustacean accessory claw orlongtail.
Muted matte warm-gray shell and softunderside are artistic, not originalcolor evidence.
restoration_boundaries: Plate5allimages are UB822 actual SEM; shield edge partlyremoved andfrontbroken. Fig2 is author h1reconstruction, notadditionalphotograph.
Fig6 late-meraspid appendages are used only as declared neighboring-stage anatomical supplement; text states small changes toh1 andninepairs inh1. Lasttrunklimb h1 is developed beyondbud.
Do not use stage1bphoto from2009 as two-thoracic main specimen. Do not claim UB87fromanothercrustaceanpaper as Agnostus.
No rigid fullunrolling toshowalllimbs; gapingposture preserves completeanimal anddistincttwojointedtergites.
Exact distalantennule count, microsetae, missingtip lengths andsoftbodycontour inferred.

reference_credits.title: Muller and Walossek1987, Morphology, ontogeny, and life habit of Agnostus pisiformis, Fossils and Strata19

description.en: A giant beaver reconstruction with grooved incisors, a deep body and a conservative narrow tapered tail. It combines separate fossil evidence; tail form and other soft tissues remain interpretations, not a modern paddle-tail copy.
description.zh: 巨型河狸的完整复原，具有纵沟门齿、厚躯与保守的狭长渐细尾。综合不同化石证据，尾形及其他软组织仍属解释，不照搬现代扁桨尾。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole giant beaver: broad rodent skull, paired large longitudinally grooved incisors, deep-bodied aquatic outline with conservative narrow tapered tail.

scientific_limits.en: Composite reconstruction, not one complete fossil. Minnesota skeleton photograph is juvenile with no scale/catalog visible; do not assign adult maximum to that individual. Wood1914 Pittsfield skull dimensions differ from NYSM VP47 dorsal skull photograph. Bell Museum maximum7ft is species-level approximate total, not measured headbody. Narrow tail is probable museum interpretation, webbing/fur/ears/color inferred. No modern broad paddle or dam-building scene.
scientific_limits.zh: 综合活体复原而非同一完整标本。明尼苏达骨架照片是幼体，无尺/编号，不套成年最大尺寸。1914 Pittsfield颅测量与NYSM VP47颅图不同件。博物馆7英尺是属种大致最长估值非实测头体长；细长尾为可能解释，蹼毛耳色推定，无现代扁桨尾或筑坝场景。

frozen_scientific_scope.classification: Mammalia, Rodentia, Castoridae; not extant Castor.

scale.status: Skull dimensions Wood1914 reported; body/tail/shoulder/width are artistic estimates, total2.05m under museum approximate7ft maximum, no specimen-level total claim.

diagnostic_targets: Broad low rodent head and broad zygomatic silhouette, not narrow doglike muzzle.
Paired curved upper and lower incisors visible at slightly open mouth; longitudinal fluting modeled cheaply, not smooth modern chisel blades.
Deep barrel torso, short forelimbs and larger hindfeet; full four-limbed animal.
Narrow long tapering tail, not broad flat Castor paddle; soft tail crosssection inferred.
Conservative inferred aquatic mammal flesh/fur and modest webbing, no haircards or water scene.

description.en: A complete hadrosaur reconstruction with an expanded tall cranial crest rather than the obsolete narrow rod. The crest combines incomplete material; missing regions, soft tissues, colour and stance are reconstructed.
description.zh: 完整鸭嘴龙类复原，采用扩展高头冠而非过时的细棒冠。头冠综合不完整材料，缺失部位、软组织、颜色与站姿为复原。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete hadrosaur with modern expanded tall cranial crest, dedicated2013/2020 form review, full trunk, four limbs and long tail. Never obsolete unicorn rod or skull-only object.

scientific_limits.en: Crest reconstruction synthesizes multiple fragmentary specimens, not a complete preserved crest. Follow Zhang etal2020 Fig4 expanded crest with more rostrally inclined nasal and near-horizontal rear skull roof; white areas are reconstructed. CT shows nasal spine itself solid/sandwich-like, not a hollow pipe; this does not disprove the larger hollow crest. Body mount is composite and historically posed, with obsolete rod crest and pronated hands not adopted.12m is NHM genus estimate, not measured photographed skeleton. Soft tissue, colour and posture inferred.
scientific_limits.zh: 头冠整合多个零碎标本，不是保存完整头冠。采用Zhang等2020图4较向前倾鼻突和较水平后头顶的扩展高冠，白色缺失部位为复原。CT说明鼻突骨本身为实心夹层而非空管，不等于否定整体中空头冠。躯体装架为合成及历史姿势，旧棒冠和旋前手不采用。12米为NHM属估，非照片骨架实测。软组织、颜色及站姿为推定。

scale.basis: NHM genus estimate; not measured IVPP individual or modern reconstructed crest.

diagnostic_targets: Tall expanded lobate cranial crest with broad rounded summit and continuous connection toward snout, not solitary thin unicorn spike.
Follow2020Fig4: slightly rostrally inclined nasal support and subhorizontal caudal skull roof, not2013 posterior tilt.
Crest narrow across head in frontal view but broad in lateral view; not Corythosaurus round helmet or Parasaurolophus long back tube.
Duckbill, deep hadrosaur trunk, substantial hindlimbs, shorter forelimbs and long tapering tail.
Palms inward/functional supported forefeet without historical splayed pronated grasping hands.
frozen_scientific_scope.specimen_basis: Actually viewed2013Fig2 IVPPV725/V829 fossil photographs andFig7 reconstructed skull;2020Fig4 revised interpretation;2008Captmondo museum composite mount for torso/limb context only.

Zhang etal2020 Internal morphology of nasal spine of Tsintaosaurus spinorhinus
Tsintaosaurus NaturalHistoryMuseum DinoDirectory

description.en: A whole Pliosaurus carpenteri reconstruction anchored to BRSMG Cd6172. Much of the postcranial skeleton is incomplete, so missing paddles, axial regions, tail length and soft-tissue contours are explicitly inferred.
description.zh: 以BRSMG Cd6172为依据的Pliosaurus carpenteri完整复原。颅后骨架多处不完整，缺失鳍肢、中轴部位、尾长和软组织轮廓均明确属于推断。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole living reconstruction of Pliosaurus carpenteri anchored to BRSMG Cd6172, not a skull-only asset. Original inventory allows choosing a species/specimen before anatomy approval; this fixes that choice. Incomplete postcranium is explicitly reconstructed.

scientific_limits.en: BRSMG Cd6172 is incomplete: only one fairly complete limb, about half the vertebrae and fewer than half the ribs survive. The skull is dorsoventrally crushed and has missing roofing/temporal components; published restored width and height are not wholly measured preserved dimensions. Approximately 8 m total is a reconstruction estimate; 1.8 m skull is the published specimen-based maximum length. Mirrored forelimb, both hindflippers, missing axial elements, tail extent and soft-tissue contours are inferred, not complete original bones. Do not use P.kevani or P.funkei heads. Jaw pathology is not treated as normal species anatomy; healthy soft-tissue restoration is inferred. Sex/color/skin pattern are not established.
scientific_limits.zh: BRSMG Cd6172仅保留一条较完整鳍肢、约半数椎骨及不足半数肋骨。头骨背腹压扁，顶骨架部分缺失；论文复原宽高并非全为保存实测。约8米全长是复原估计，1.8米头骨为论文标本基础最大长。对侧前鳍、双后鳍、缺失中轴骨、尾长及软组织轮廓均属明确推定，不冒完整原骨。不换用P.kevani或P.funkei头部。原个体颌病变不当种正常形态，健康活体补全推定。性别、肤色及花纹不确证。

original_scope.en: Planned animal asset: very broad robust jaw frame and a powerfully thick neck base.
original_scope.zh: 规划中的动物资产：极宽粗壮的颌架与强健厚颈基。

specimen_lock.original_inventory_species_lock: none; explicitly requires preparer to choose species/specimen
specimen_lock.taxonomic_reconciliation: Sassoon2012 described Pliosaurus sp.indet.; Benson2013 names the SAME BRSMG Cd6172 as P.carpenteri. Not a different specimen or mixed head.
specimen_lock.horizon: Upper Kimmeridgian, Kimmeridge Clay, Westbury, Wiltshire, UK

scale.total_length_basis: Larkin2017 firsthand conservator: about8m in life; estimated reconstructed whole, not complete skeleton measure.
scale.published_skull_length_to_restored_width: 7:3 (Sassoon2012 p746); maximum width estimated in reconstruction
scale.subdivision_limit: These component targets are modeling estimates calibrated to original skull and conservator whole layout. No invented precision: maker may modestly adjust within evidence for coherent masses, never imply directly measured body subdivisions.

evidence_anchors.skull: Sassoon2012 original PDF p746 Fig2 dorsal/ventral/lateral reconstruction with400mm scale; p747 Fig3 original dorsal skull photo with200mm scale, both actually viewed. Wide posterior jaw frame, triangular taper, slight anterior rosette, large heterodont teeth. Dotted restored regions explicit.
evidence_anchors.body: Larkin2017 original overhead specimen layout photo actually viewed. Bone gaps and outlines distinguish original bone from completed animal; one real forelimb photo also viewed. Short broad neck transition and substantial trunk are restored soft tissue supported by skeletal layout, not preserved flesh.
evidence_anchors.classification: Benson2013 pp9–10 names P.carpenteri, holotype BRSMG Cd6172, Upper Kimmeridgian; fully trihedral teeth and cervical characteristics. Its other-species figures must NOT supply this model head.
evidence_anchors.scale: Sassoon2012 specimen maximum skull1.8m and restored length:width7:3; Larkin2017 about8m total is estimated. No multiplication of giant P.funkei flipper values.

morphology: Broad posterior triangular jaw/head frame, narrowing into long snout with slight premaxillary rosette. Head occupies about22.5% total length, not tiny elasmosaur head or dolphin beak. Preserve large robust tooth-bearing jaw.

Wide muscular short neck transition joining large head to broad fusiform trunk; no slender elasmosaur neck or abrupt pinched stalk. Neck soft-tissue thickness is a reconstruction, not measured muscle.

Four distinct long tapered paddles with thickness and smooth integrated roots. One forelimb directly evidenced; opposite forelimb mirrored and hindlimbs reconstructed explicitly. Keep clear negative space between limbs and body.
Conservative tapering short tail, no giant fish crescent, dorsalfin or whale fluke. Missing tail extent inferred. Neutral nearly horizontal swimming pose.

Heterodont robust pointed teeth, fully trihedral tendency simplified; several anterior caniniforms, modest jaw gape12degrees. Do not copy crushing, holes, abscess or dislocation as normal live anatomy.
Restrained slate/olive dorsal and lighter ventral palette, artistic not scientific. Avoid armor, spikes, display rods or exposed fossil skeleton.

shape_gate.original_required_combination: Very broad robust jaw frame plus powerfully thick neck base, without reliance on name, color, scale or pose. Whole organism required.

original_requirements_audit.species_specimen: P.carpenteri BRSMG Cd6172 selected and verified; inventory did not mandate another
original_requirements_audit.source_scope: Original source was group-only; new specimen-specific primary paper and actual reference images close research prerequisite
original_requirements_audit.specific_three_way_test: Not required by this original record. Do not import or waive Styxosaurus gate.

shape_gate.comparisons: Against Dolichorhynchops/plesiosaur candidates, preserve large broad-based robust head and short thick neck, not merely a resized slim pointed head. Against future Liopleurodon, do not claim established genus-wide separation from name alone; assess actual broad jaw/neck combination visually. No active Liopleurodon candidate is used as evidence.
acceptance: Lateral front view shows substantial large head, short strong neck transition and coherent full animal.
Top shows broad triangular posterior skull relative to snout, broad neck attachment and all four separated flippers.
Head-on side view shows jaw/neck volume; do not flatten to fossil150mm preserved thickness.
Whole perspective retains jaw-frame and neck-base legibility without labels or color; add a head close-up only if needed to inspect teeth, never to substitute for unreadable whole gate.

description.en: A gracile bipedal reconstruction with a long shallow snout and three nasal bumps. The anchor is an immature Alioramus altai; missing limbs, soft tissues and pose are inferred, and adult proportions or absence of feathers are not asserted.
description.zh: 纤细双足复原，具有长浅吻和三处鼻隆突。依据未成年Alioramus altai，缺失肢骨、软组织与姿态为推断，不宣称成年比例或确定无羽。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole gracile biped with exceptionally long shallow snout and a row of nasal bumps, full trunk, limbs and long balancing tail; not isolated skull.

scientific_limits.en: IGM100/1844 is a nine-year-old juvenile, not a documented adult. Nearly complete disarticulated skull plus partial postcranium; forelimbs, pubes, regions of hindlimbs and much of dorsal/caudal series are missing. Fig3 fills missing regions; skin, colour, muscle contours and pose inferred. About6m is AustralianMuseum estimate, not measured complete fossil. Adopt three nasal rugosities of A.altai, not six more prominent bumps of A.remotus. Do not claim adult proportions or feather absence established.
scientific_limits.zh: IGM100/1844为9岁未成年，非已证实成年比例。近完整散离头骨加部分躯体，前肢、耻骨、部分后肢及较多背尾椎缺失，图3含补配。皮肤、颜色、肌肉轮廓及姿态推定。约6米为澳洲博物馆估计非完整化石实测。采用A.altai三处鼻隆突，不混A.remotus六处显著隆突；不能断言无羽。

scale.basis: Australian Museum about6m estimate; Fig3 reconstruction uses2m scale bar; not complete fossil measurement.

diagnostic_targets: Very long shallow snout, approximately anterior two-thirds of skull length, not a deep robust Tyrannosaurus head.
Three discrete modest midline nasal bumps visible in side view, based on Fig1B actual fossil and text; not six tall horns from A.remotus.
Paired lateral jugal horn projections behind mouth and modest orbital ornament; lateral jugal horn differs from ventral cornual process.
Slender trunk and elongated hindlimbs, short inferred two-fingered forelimbs, palms inward, long balanced tail.
Entire animal with skin-covered bones; skeletal windows are not holes in the living face.
frozen_scientific_scope.specimen_basis: Brusatte etal2009 IGM100/1844 Fig1 true maxilla/nasal/lacrimal/jugal/dentary photos and composite skull drawing, Fig3 partial skeleton reconstruction and true cervical photos, actually viewed.

University of Edinburgh repository original2009 paper
Australian Museum Alioramus altai factsheet

description.en: A conservative living Elrathia reconstruction with an oval dorsal shield, closely repeated thoracic ribs and a small tail shield. Ventral limbs are comparative restorations, not soft tissues preserved in the anchor fossil; colour and fine details are uncertain.
description.zh: 保守的Elrathia活体复原，具有椭圆背甲、紧密胸部肋节与小尾盾。腹肢为比较复原，并非主锚化石保存的软组织；颜色和细部仍不确定。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete conservative living Elrathia centered on the larger individual of museum specimen group PRI76837: plain oval dorsal test, closely repeated thoracic ribs and small rounded pygidium; restrained inferred ventral limbs, not fossil slab.

scientific_limits.en: PRI76837 contains two fossils. The museum gives approximately40mm for the larger and30mm for the smaller; only the larger anchors this model. Viewed image is a museum fossil-scan preview, not a photograph of living anatomy. Ventral appendages are not visible and are explicitly group-informed restoration, not preserved PRI soft parts. Exact pygidial limb count, thickness, posture, fine setae and color are uncertain.
scientific_limits.zh: PRI76837包含两件化石；馆方大件约40毫米、小件约30毫米，本模型仅用大件作尺度锚。已看图为馆藏实物扫描预览，非活体照片。腹肢不可见，明确属于三叶虫类群层级的保守补配，不是PRI实存软组织；尾盾腹肢精确数、体厚、姿态、细毛与颜色不确定。

scale.uncertainty: Museum approximate length forlargerindividual, remainingratios estimatedfromobliqueimage; notorthographicmetrology. Do not scale fromsmallerspecimen orslab.

anatomy: Plain oval outline with semicircular broad head, modest central glabella, small lateral compound eyes and short genalpoints. No elaborate knobs, hugeeyes orlongcephalicspines.

Thirteen closely spaced free thoracic tergites, narrowraised centralaxis and broader flattenedpleuralribs; simple short swept-back tips, no tall axialspines. Adult13segmentcondition supportedbyBright1959 andHopkins2021; notallontogeneticstagesidentical.
Small rounded pygidium, narrowfaintraisedaxialarea andsmoothoutermargin; no longtailspike orradiatingtailspines. Fusedpygidialrings must not be counted as additionalfree thoracictergites.
Paired slender antennules underfronthead and three smallpostantennularcephalic limb pairs conservatively restored frompolymeridtrilobitebodyplan.
One paired biramous limb unit under eachof13thoracicsegments, endopodwalkingramus and restrainedouterfilamentbranch. Keepunderpleurae, notgills onback orhugeexposed shrimp paddles.
Four progressively smaller pygidial limb pairs are anexplicit visualizationchoice, notameasuredspeciescount. Keepmostlyundershield andsimplified; precise hiddenmicroanatomynotclaimed.
Subduedslate/earthtone livecolors areartistic, notblackfossilpreservation orstone texture. Fullbody withlowwalkingclearance, noattachedrock.
restoration_boundaries: Primary reference islargerPRI76837specimen shownatupperleft inviewedpreview; smallerindividual onlycontext, notmixedscale.
Onlydorsaltest directlysupported byPRIimage. Allventralbodyandappendages group-informed, withuncertainty preserved inpublicdescription.
Bright1959abstractreportsusual13thoracicsegments andfourvisibleaxialpygidialsegments; publishedsegmentinterpretations vary, do not equate visibleaxialrings withprovenlimbcount.
Houetal2021Triarthrus/Olenoides evidence onlysupports generalbiramousventralorganization; do notborrowTriarthrus14thoracicsegments orassertidenticalfinegillattachment.
Originalplainoval+ribs+smallroundtailgate retained, no dramaticrecolor/pose substitutefordistinctanatomy.

description.en: A whole Daeodon reconstruction with a very large deep head, expanded cheek flanges and a comparatively narrow torso. The skeletal mount anchors the form; lips, skin, ears, tail and colour are inferred.
description.zh: Daeodon的完整复原，具有巨大深厚头部、扩展颊突与相对狭窄躯干。以骨骼装架为形态依据，唇、皮肤、耳尾和颜色为推断。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete animal with very large deep head, expanded lateral cheek flanges and comparatively narrow torso. Anchor CM1594 skeleton, not historical skin sculpture CM2503.

scientific_limits.en: CM1594 mounted fossil is the form anchor, not historical soft-tissue sculpture CM2503. Museum approximately six feet shoulder height is an estimate, not exact bone measurement. Lucas etal1998 CM1594 tooth lengths are directly reported; body dimensions selected below are modeling estimates. Cheek flanges are not the huge anterior chin tubercles of Archaeotherium: CM1594 has only a small chin tubercle. Lips, skin, ears, tail flesh, color inferred. No literal giant domestic pig, no certainty about all modern phylogenetic details.
scientific_limits.zh: 以CM1594真实展骨为形态锚，不用CM2503历史皮肤像。博物馆约六英尺肩高是估值非精确骨测；1998论文CM1594牙尺寸为报告值，全体参数另为美术估计。宽颊突不等于Archaeotherium巨大前下颏瘤，CM1594仅小下颏结节；唇皮耳尾色推定，不造巨型家猪。

frozen_scientific_scope.classification: Mammalia, Artiodactyla, Entelodontidae; Dinohyus hollandi historical synonym, not modern Suidae.

scale.status: Tooth measurements directly reported Table2 p431; museumheight approximate; all other dimensions artistic estimates, not newly measured skeleton or species mean.

diagnostic_targets: Huge elongated deep skull with strongly expanded paired lateral cheek arches/flanges.
Small chin tubercle only, no Archaeotherium-like huge anterior chin bosses.
Comparatively narrow deep torso supported by four relatively long legs and paired central hooves.
High shoulder support and substantial neck for heavy head, avoid giant round domestic pig torso.
Modest mouth opening reveals conical teeth/canines without exaggerated warthog curling tusks.
Complete body and narrow shortish tail, restrained inferred skin/ears/color.
